--13980912 UPDATE tVer SET ver = N'VkFCV0FGSUFUZ0JPQUZVQU9RQkVBRThBU0FCa0FGQUFWUUI2QUdnQU5BQlVBRmNBWXdCeUFGRUFWUUJSQUhjQVVRQldBRUlBVWdCTUFGRUFQUUE5QUE9PQ==' GO alter PROCEDURE spRpt_StdCard @Class varchar(500) , @xYear int with encryption as
SELECT tYear_Student.xPaye, tYear_Student.xClass, tYear_Student.xStudent, tYear_Student.sort, tStudent.FName, tStudent.LName,tStudent.PName,tStudent.code, tClass.name AS Class, tPaye.Name AS Paye, tParmetr.heder1, tParmetr.sch, tStudent.NumberAsas, tStudent.RegDate,cast(tClass.xYear as nvarchar(4)) as xYear,dbo.tStudentImg.Student_img FROM tStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id left outer JOIN dbo.tStudentImg ON dbo.tStudent.id = dbo.tStudentImg.xStudent CROSS JOIN tParmetr WHERE (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear) and tYear_Student.xclass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.status<>2
GO alter procedure sp_Procc @Exam int with encryption as declare @xYear int select @xYear=xYear from texam where id=@Exam
------------------------------------------------------------ declare @xterm int select @xterm=term from texam where id=@Exam
if(@xterm=3) begin
declare @ExamTerm1 int declare @ExamTerm2 int
select @ExamTerm1=id from texam where term=1 and xYear=@xYear select @ExamTerm2=id from texam where term=2 and xYear=@xYear
delete from tmark where xtest=@Exam insert into tmark (xstudent,xbook,xtest,typ) select distinct xStudent,xbook ,@Exam,1 FROM tMark WHERE (Xtest IN (@ExamTerm1, @ExamTerm2))
update tmark set m1= tMark_1.Mark FROM tMark INNER JOIN tMark tMark_1 ON tMark.xStudent = tMark_1.xStudent AND tMark.typ = tMark_1.typ AND tMark.xbook = tMark_1.xbook WHERE (tMark.Xtest = @Exam) AND (tMark_1.Xtest = @ExamTerm1)
update tmark set m2= tMark_1.Mark FROM tMark INNER JOIN tMark tMark_1 ON tMark.xStudent = tMark_1.xStudent AND tMark.typ = tMark_1.typ AND tMark.xbook = tMark_1.xbook WHERE (tMark.Xtest = @Exam) AND (tMark_1.Xtest = @ExamTerm2)
update tmark set mark =isnull(m1,0)+isnull(m2,0) where xtest=@Exam end ------------------------
delete from tmark where Xtest=@Exam and typ<>1 update tMark set gClass=null,gKoll=null,xExportRpt=null where Xtest=@Exam declare @xbook int declare @xtest bigint declare @xClass bigint declare @xStudent bigint declare @Mark float declare @tmp_Mark float declare @Rotbe int declare @tmp_Rotbe int
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1
create table #tmp ( Xtest bigint,xClass int,xbook int ,mark float,gClass smallint) insert into #tmp SELECT distinct tMark.Xtest, tYear_Student.xClass, tMark.xbook, round(tMark.Mark,6),null
FROM tMark INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMark.xStudent = tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent where tMark.mark is not null and tMark.Xtest=@Exam AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
declare Rbt cursor for select distinct xbook,Xtest,xClass from #tmp open Rbt fetch next from Rbt into @xbook,@xtest,@xClass while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin declare Rbt2 cursor for select mark from #tmp where xbook= @xbook and Xtest=@xtest and xClass=@xClass order by mark desc open Rbt2 fetch next from Rbt2 into @mark
set @Rotbe=1 while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin
UPDATE #tmp SET gClass = @Rotbe WHERE xClass=@xClass and xbook= @xbook and mark=@mark
set @Rotbe=@Rotbe+1
fetch next from Rbt2 into @mark end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
set @Rotbe=1 fetch next from Rbt into @xbook,@xtest,@xClass end close Rbt deallocate Rbt
update tMark set tMark.gClass=#tmp.gClass from tMark inner join #tmp on round(tMark.mark,6)=#tmp.mark and tMark.xbook=#tmp.xbook and tMark.Xtest=#tmp.Xtest
inner join tyear_student on tMark.xStudent=tyear_student.xStudent and #tmp.xClass=tyear_student.xClass where tyear_student.xYear=@xYear
delete from #tmp
insert into #tmp SELECT distinct tMark.Xtest, null, tMark.xbook, round(tMark.Mark,6),null
FROM tMark INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMark.xStudent = tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent where tMark.mark is not null and tMark.Xtest=@Exam AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
declare Rbt cursor for select distinct xbook,Xtest from #tmp open Rbt fetch next from Rbt into @xbook,@xtest while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin declare Rbt2 cursor for select mark from #tmp where xbook= @xbook and Xtest=@xtest order by mark desc open Rbt2 fetch next from Rbt2 into @mark
set @Rotbe=1 while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin
UPDATE #tmp SET gClass = @Rotbe WHERE xbook= @xbook and mark=@mark set @Rotbe=@Rotbe+1
fetch next from Rbt2 into @mark end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
set @Rotbe=1
fetch next from Rbt into @xbook,@xtest end close Rbt deallocate Rbt
update tMark set tMark.gkoll=#tmp.gClass from tMark inner join #tmp on round(tMark.mark,6)=#tmp.mark and tMark.xbook=#tmp.xbook and tMark.Xtest=#tmp.Xtest inner join tyear_student on tMark.xStudent=tyear_student.xStudent where tyear_student.xYear=@xYear
drop table #tmp
GO alter procedure dbo.sp_CalcMarkDoreh @Exam int with encryption as declare @xYear int declare @xTerm int select @xYear=xYear,@xTerm=term from texam where id=@Exam delete from tMarkDoreh where Xtest=@Exam and typ<>4
declare @zarib100 float if(@xTerm=0) set @zarib100=1 else if(@xTerm=1) set @zarib100=2.5 else if(@xTerm=2) set @zarib100=1.666666 else if(@xTerm=3) set @zarib100=1
if (@xTerm=0) INSERT INTO tMarkDoreh (xStudent, Xtest, typ, MarkDoreh,SumMark,MarkDoreh100,acp) SELECT tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest, 5 AS Expr1, SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) AS Expr2, SUM(tMark.Mark), round(SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) *@zarib100,6),1 FROM tMark INNER JOIN tBook ON tMark.xbook = tBook.id WHERE (tMark.Mark IS NOT NULL) and (tMark.Xtest =@Exam) and tBook.vahed>0 GROUP BY tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest else INSERT INTO tMarkDoreh (xStudent, Xtest, typ, MarkDoreh,SumMark,MarkDoreh100,acp) SELECT tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest, 5 AS Expr1, SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) AS Expr2, SUM(tMark.Mark), round(SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) *@zarib100,6),1 FROM tMark INNER JOIN tBook ON tMark.xbook = tBook.id WHERE (tMark.Mark IS NOT NULL) and (tMark.Xtest =@Exam) and tBook.vahed>0 and tBook.Vezarat=1 GROUP BY tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest
if(@xTerm=1) begin update tMarkDoreh set acp=0 where xtest=@Exam and xstudent in( select xstudent as countB from tmark where xtest=@Exam and xbook in(select id from tbook where Vezarat=1) and mark <16 group by xstudent having count(*)>=1)
update tMarkDoreh set acp=0 where xtest=@Exam and MarkDoreh<20
end else if(@xTerm=3) begin
update tMarkDoreh set acp=2 where xtest=@Exam --and MarkDoreh>=50 and xstudent in( select xstudent as countB from tmark where xtest=@Exam and xbook in(select id from tbook where Vezarat=1) and mark <40 group by xstudent having count(*)<=3)
update tMarkDoreh set acp=0 where xtest=@Exam and xstudent in( select xstudent as countB from tmark where xtest=@Exam and xbook in(select id from tbook where Vezarat=1) and mark <40 group by xstudent having count(*)>3)
update tMarkDoreh set acp=0 where xtest=@Exam and MarkDoreh<50 end
declare @xClass int declare @xPaye int declare @xStudent int declare @Mark float declare @tmp_Mark float declare @Rotbe int declare @tmp_Rotbe int
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1
create table #tmp ( xStudent bigint,xClass int,xPaye int,mark float,gClass smallint,gPaye smallint,gKoll smallint) insert into #tmp SELECT tMarkDoreh.xStudent, tYear_Student.xClass,tYear_Student.xPaye, tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, NULL AS Expr1 , NULL AS Expr2, NULL AS Expr3
FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent
where tMarkDoreh.Xtest=@Exam and typ=5 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
---------------------------------------------------------------------- declare Rbt cursor for select distinct xPaye,xClass from #tmp open Rbt fetch next from Rbt into @xPaye,@xClass while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin declare Rbt2 cursor for select xStudent,mark from #tmp where xPaye=@xPaye and xClass=@xClass order by mark desc open Rbt2 fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Mark=1000 while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin if @tmp_Mark <> @Mark begin UPDATE #tmp SET gClass = @tmp_Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent set @Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe end else begin UPDATE #tmp SET gClass = @Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent end
set @tmp_Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe+1 set @tmp_Mark = @Mark
fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
fetch next from Rbt into @xPaye,@xClass end close Rbt deallocate Rbt -----------------------------------------------------
declare Rbt cursor for select distinct xPaye from #tmp open Rbt fetch next from Rbt into @xPaye while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin declare Rbt2 cursor for select xStudent,mark from #tmp where xPaye=@xPaye order by mark desc open Rbt2 fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Mark=1000 while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin if @tmp_Mark <> @Mark begin UPDATE #tmp SET gPaye = @tmp_Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent set @Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe end else begin UPDATE #tmp SET gPaye = @Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent end
set @tmp_Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe+1 set @tmp_Mark = @Mark
fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
fetch next from Rbt into @xPaye end close Rbt deallocate Rbt ---------------------------------------------------- declare Rbt2 cursor for select xStudent,mark from #tmp order by mark desc open Rbt2 fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Mark=1000 while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin if @tmp_Mark <> @Mark begin UPDATE #tmp SET gKoll = @tmp_Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent set @Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe end else begin UPDATE #tmp SET gKoll = @Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent end
set @tmp_Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe+1 set @tmp_Mark = @Mark
fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
update tMarkDoreh set tMarkDoreh.gClass2=#tmp.gClass, tMarkDoreh.gPaye2=#tmp.gPaye,tMarkDoreh.gKoll2=#tmp.gKoll from tMarkDoreh inner join #tmp on tMarkDoreh.xStudent=#tmp.xStudent and tMarkDoreh.Xtest=@Exam and tMarkDoreh.typ=5 drop table #tmp
------aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa--------------------------------

FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent

while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin
UPDATE #tmp2 SET gClass = @Rotbe WHERE xClass=@xClass and mark=@mark set @Rotbe=@Rotbe+1
fetch next from Rbt2 into @mark
end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
set @Rotbe=1
fetch next from Rbt into @xClass end close Rbt deallocate Rbt

-----------------------------------------------------
insert into #tmp2 SELECT distinct tYear_Student.xPaye,round( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,6), NULL AS Expr1
FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent
where tMarkDoreh.Xtest=@Exam and typ=5 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
---------------------------------------------------------------------- declare Rbt cursor for select distinct xClass from #tmp2 open Rbt fetch next from Rbt into @xClass while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin declare Rbt2 cursor for select mark from #tmp2 where xClass=@xClass order by mark desc open Rbt2 fetch next from Rbt2 into @mark
set @Rotbe=1
while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin
UPDATE #tmp2 SET gClass = @Rotbe WHERE xClass=@xClass and mark=@mark set @Rotbe=@Rotbe+1
fetch next from Rbt2 into @mark
end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
set @Rotbe=1
fetch next from Rbt into @xClass end close Rbt deallocate Rbt
update tMarkDoreh set tMarkDoreh.gPaye=#tmp2.gClass from tMarkDoreh inner join #tmp2 on round(tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,6)=#tmp2.mark inner join tyear_student on tMarkDoreh.xStudent=tyear_student.xStudent and #tmp2.xClass=tyear_student.xPaye where tyear_student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.xtest=@Exam and tMarkDoreh.typ=5

insert into #tmp2 SELECT distinct null,round( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,6), NULL AS Expr1
FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent
where tMarkDoreh.Xtest=@Exam and typ=5 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)

fetch next from Rbt2 into @mark
end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
update tMarkDoreh set tMarkDoreh.gKoll=#tmp2.gClass from tMarkDoreh inner join #tmp2 on round(tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,6)=#tmp2.mark inner join tyear_student on tMarkDoreh.xStudent=tyear_student.xStudent where tyear_student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.xtest=@Exam and tMarkDoreh.typ=5
drop table #tmp2 GO update texam set procc=0 GO ALTER TABLE dbo.tClass ADD countDakhele1 smallint NULL, countDakhele2 smallint NULL, countExam1 smallint NULL, countExam2 smallint NULL, countAcp1 smallint NULL, countAcp2 smallint NULL, countNoAcp1 smallint NULL, countNoAcp2 smallint NULL, countMashrot1 smallint NULL, countMashrot2 smallint NULL, countMazerati1 smallint NULL, countMazerati2 smallint NULL, countAbsent1 smallint NULL, countAbsent2 smallint NULL

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spRpt_karnamefinal @Exam varchar(500), @Class varchar(500) , @xYear int-- with encryption AS
declare @ExamTerm1 int declare @ExamTerm2 int
select @ExamTerm1=id from texam where term=1 and xYear=@xYear select @ExamTerm2=id from texam where term=2 and xYear=@xYear
declare @xTest int declare @xbook int declare @book nvarchar(100) declare @xPaye int declare @tmp_xTest int declare @tmp_xPaye int declare @counter int declare @Sql nvarchar(500) declare @sort int
set @tmp_xTest =0 set @tmp_xPaye =0 set @counter=1
create table #tmpTable (xStudent int,xTest int,xPaye int,MarkKoll float,Summark float,tosifM nvarchar(10),level5 smallint,gschkoll int,gclsKoll int,gPayeKoll int,Acp int, xbook1 int,book1 nvarchar(100),M1_1 float,M2_1 float,M3_1 float, xbook2 int,book2 nvarchar(100),M1_2 float,M2_2 float,M3_2 float, xbook3 int,book3 nvarchar(100),M1_3 float,M2_3 float,M3_3 float, xbook4 int,book4 nvarchar(100),M1_4 float,M2_4 float,M3_4 float, xbook5 int,book5 nvarchar(100),M1_5 float,M2_5 float,M3_5 float, xbook6 int,book6 nvarchar(100),M1_6 float,M2_6 float,M3_6 float, xbook7 int,book7 nvarchar(100),M1_7 float,M2_7 float,M3_7 float, xbook8 int,book8 nvarchar(100),M1_8 float,M2_8 float,M3_8 float, xbook9 int,book9 nvarchar(100),M1_9 float,M2_9 float,M3_9 float, xbook10 int,book10 nvarchar(100),M1_10 float,M2_10 int,M3_10 float, xbook11 int,book11 nvarchar(100),M1_11 float,M2_11 int,M3_11 float, xbook12 int,book12 nvarchar(100),M1_12 float,M2_12 int,M3_12 float, xbook13 int,book13 nvarchar(100),M1_13 float,M2_13 int,M3_13 float, xbook14 int,book14 nvarchar(100),M1_14 float,M2_14 int,M3_14 float, xbook15 int,book15 nvarchar(100),M1_15 float,M2_15 int,M3_15 float, xbook16 int,book16 nvarchar(100),M1_16 float,M2_16 int,M3_16 float, xbook17 int,book17 nvarchar(100),M1_17 float,M2_17 int,M3_17 float, xbook18 int,book18 nvarchar(100),M1_18 float,M2_18 int,M3_18 float, xbook19 int,book19 nvarchar(100),M1_19 float,M2_19 int,M3_19 float, xbook20 int,book20 nvarchar(100),M1_20 float,M2_20 int,M3_20 float, xbook21 int,book21 nvarchar(100),M1_21 float,M2_21 int,M3_21 float, MAgo_1 float, MAgo_2 float, MAgo_3 float, MAgo_4 float, MAgo_5 float, MAgo_6 float, MAgo_7 float, MAgo_8 float, MAgo_9 float, MAgo_10 float, MAgo_11 float, MAgo_12 float, MAgo_13 float, MAgo_14 float, MAgo_15 float, MAgo_16 float, MAgo_17 float, MAgo_18 float, MAgo_19 float, MAgo_20 float, MAgo_21 float, MAgo2_1 float, MAgo2_2 float, MAgo2_3 float, MAgo2_4 float, MAgo2_5 float, MAgo2_6 float, MAgo2_7 float, MAgo2_8 float, MAgo2_9 float, MAgo2_10 float, MAgo2_11 float, MAgo2_12 float, MAgo2_13 float, MAgo2_14 float, MAgo2_15 float, MAgo2_16 float, MAgo2_17 float, MAgo2_18 float, MAgo2_19 float, MAgo2_20 float, MAgo2_21 float, MarkKoll1 float, Summark1 float, Acp1 int, gclsKoll1 int, tosifM_1 nvarchar(10), level5_1 smallint, Summark2 float, MarkKoll2 float, )
insert into #tmpTable (xStudent,xtest,xPaye,MarkKoll,Summark,tosifM,level5,gschkoll,gPayeKoll,gclsKoll,acp) SELECT distinct tMarkDoreh.xStudent,tMarkDoreh.Xtest,tYear_Student.XPaye,tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, tMarkDoreh.Summark,dbo.ReturnTosifM5(tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as TosifM ,dbo.ReturnLevel5(tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as level5, tMarkDoreh.gKoll,tMarkDoreh.gPaye,tMarkDoreh.gclass,acp FROM tStudent INNER JOIN tMarkDoreh ON tStudent.id = tMarkDoreh.xStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tMarkDoreh.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
update #tmpTable set MarkKoll1=tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,Summark1=tmpMark1.Summark,Acp1=tmpMark1.acp,gclsKoll1=tmpMark1.gClass, tosifM_1=dbo.ReturnTosifM5(tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,@ExamTerm1,tmpMark1.xStudent), level5_1=dbo.ReturnLevel5(tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,@ExamTerm1,tmpMark1.xStudent)
from #tmpTable inner join ( SELECT xStudent, MarkDoreh, gClass, Summark, acp FROM tMarkDoreh WHERE (typ = 5) AND (Xtest = @ExamTerm1))tmpMark1 on #tmpTable.xstudent=tmpMark1.xstudent
update #tmpTable set MarkKoll2=tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,Summark2=tmpMark1.Summark from #tmpTable inner join ( SELECT xStudent, MarkDoreh, gClass, Summark, acp FROM tMarkDoreh WHERE (typ = 5) AND (Xtest = @ExamTerm2))tmpMark1 on #tmpTable.xstudent=tmpMark1.xstudent
declare Test cursor for SELECT DISTINCT dbo.tMark.Xtest, dbo.tYear_Student.xPaye, dbo.tMark.xbook, dbo.tBook.Name, dbo.tBook.sort FROM dbo.tStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tMark ON dbo.tStudent.id = dbo.tMark.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tBook ON dbo.tMark.xbook = dbo.tBook.id AND dbo.tYear_Student.xPaye = dbo.tBook.xPaye Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tMark.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear) and tBook.vezarat=1 ORDER BY tMark.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.sort, tMark.xbook open Test fetch next from Test into @xTest,@xPaye,@xbook,@book,@sort Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin
if( @tmp_xTest <>@xTest or @tmp_xPaye <>@xPaye) set @counter =1
if(@counter<22) begin set @Sql=' update #tmpTable set xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'='+convert(varchar(6),@xbook)+',book'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=N'''+@book+''''+ ' WHERE Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m3_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.mark' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.Xtest = #tmpTable.xTest AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE #tmpTable.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m2_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m2' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.Xtest = #tmpTable.xTest AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE #tmpTable.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m1_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m1' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.Xtest = #tmpTable.xTest AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE #tmpTable.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql) End set @counter=@counter+1 set @tmp_xTest=@xTest set @tmp_xPaye=@xPaye
fetch next from Test into @xTest,@xPaye,@xbook,@book,@sort
end
close Test deallocate Test
declare @sch nvarchar(100) declare @ost nvarchar(100) declare @cty nvarchar(100)
select @sch=sch,@ost=ost,@cty=cty from tParmetr

--13981112 UPDATE tVer SET ver = N'VkFCV0FGSUFUZ0JPQUZVQU9RQkVBRThBU0FCb0FFNEFWUUI2QUdnQU5BQlVBRmNBWXdCeUFGRUFWUUJSQUhjQVVRQldBRUlBVWdCTUFGRUFQUUE5QUE9PQ==' GO alter table tYear_Student add acp3 smallint, acp1 smallint GO alter FUNCTION dbo.ReturnTosifM5(@Mark float,@xExam int,@xStudent int) RETURNS nvarchar(10) with encryption AS BEGIN declare @term smallint declare @xYear smallint select @term=term,@xYear=xYear from tExam where id=@xExam
declare @Tosif nvarchar(10) if @Mark=40 and @term=1 set @Mark=39.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=3 set @Mark=99.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=0 set @Mark=99.9999
if (@term=1 or @term=3) begin declare @acp smallint if @term=1 select @acp =acp1 from tYear_Student where xStudent=@xStudent and xYear=@xYear else if @term=3 select @acp =acp3 from tYear_Student where xStudent=@xStudent and xYear=@xYear
if(@acp=1) SELECT @Tosif= tosifm FROM tTosif WHERE (fromMark <= @Mark) AND (toMark > @Mark) and term=@term else if (@acp=0 or @acp=2)
SELECT @Tosif= tosifm FROM tTosif WHERE lev=5 and term=@term
else set @Tosif=''
end
else begin SELECT @Tosif= tosifm FROM tTosif WHERE (fromMark <= @Mark) AND (toMark > @Mark) and term=@term end return @Tosif
end

)
insert into #tmpTable (xStudent,xtest,xPaye,MarkKoll,Summark,tosifM,level5,gclsKoll,AcpDef) SELECT distinct tMarkDoreh.xStudent,tMarkDoreh.Xtest,tYear_Student.XPaye,tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, tMarkDoreh.Summark,dbo.ReturnTosifM5(tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as TosifM ,dbo.ReturnLevel5(tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as level5,tMarkDoreh.gclass,Acp FROM tStudent INNER JOIN tMarkDoreh ON tStudent.id = tMarkDoreh.xStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.XClass =@xClass and tMarkDoreh.xtest=@xTest and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
if(@xTerm=3) begin ---------------محروم دائم----------- insert into #tmpTable(xStudent,xtest,xPaye,AcpDef) SELECT xStudent,@xTest, xPaye,4 FROM tYear_Student WHERE xYear=@xYear and (tYear_Student.Status = 2) and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 and tYear_Student.XClass =@xClass and xStudent not in(select xStudent from #tmpTable)

insert into #tmpTable(xStudent,xtest,xPaye,AcpDef) SELECT xStudent,@xTest, xPaye,3 FROM tYear_Student WHERE xYear=@xYear and (Status = 1) and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 and tYear_Student.XClass =@xClass and xStudent not in(select xStudent from #tmpTable)

---------------محروم دائم----------- update #tmpTable set AcpDef=4 where xStudent in(select xStudent from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear and Status=2 and XClass=@xClass)
end
else if(@xTerm=1) begin ---------------محروم ----------- insert into #tmpTable(xStudent,xtest,xPaye,AcpDef) SELECT xStudent,@xTest, xPaye,4 FROM tYear_Student WHERE xYear=@xYear and (tYear_Student.Status = 2) and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 and tYear_Student.XClass =@xClass and xStudent not in(select xStudent from #tmpTable)

--------------غايب----------- update #tmpTable set AcpDef=5 where xStudent in(select xStudent from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear and Status=4 and XClass =@xClass)
---------------محروم دائم----------- update #tmpTable set AcpDef=4 where xStudent in(select xStudent from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear and Status=2 and XClass=@xClass)
end
declare Test cursor for
SELECT DISTINCT dbo.tMark.xbook, dbo.tBook.Name, dbo.tBook.sort FROM dbo.tStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tMark ON dbo.tStudent.id = dbo.tMark.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tBook ON dbo.tMark.xbook = dbo.tBook.id AND dbo.tYear_Student.xPaye = dbo.tBook.xPaye Where tYear_Student.XClass=@xClass and tMark.xtest=@xtest AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear) and tBook.vezarat=1 ORDER BY tBook.sort, tMark.xbook
open Test fetch next from Test into @xbook,@book,@sort Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin
if(@counter<22) begin set @Sql=' update #tmpTable set xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'='+convert(varchar(6),@xbook)+',book'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=N'''+@book+''''+ ' WHERE Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set Mark'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.mark' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.Xtest = #tmpTable.xTest AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE #tmpTable.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest) exec(@Sql)
End set @counter=@counter+1
fetch next from Test into @xbook,@book,@sort
end
close Test deallocate Test

select #tmpTable.*,0 as acp ,tYear_Student.id,tYear_Student.sort,tStudent.FName,tStudent.LName,tStudent.PName,tStudent.Code, tStudent.NumberAsas, case @xTerm when 1 then tYear_Student.acp1 when 3 then tYear_Student.acp3 end as acpFinal
from #tmpTable inner join tStudent on #tmpTable.xStudent=tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent drop table #tmpTable

create PROCEDURE dbo.sp_SelectStdForSetGTerm @xTerm int, @xClass int , @xYear int with encryption AS
declare @xTest int select @xTest=id from tExam where term=@xTerm and xYear=@xYear declare @xbook int declare @book nvarchar(100) declare @counter int declare @Sql nvarchar(500) declare @sort int set @counter=1
create table #tmpTable (xStudent int,xPaye int,MarkKoll float,Summark float,gclsKoll int,AcpFinal int,gterm int)
insert into #tmpTable (xStudent,xPaye,AcpFinal,gterm,MarkKoll,Summark) SELECT tYear_Student.xStudent,tYear_Student.XPaye, case @xTerm when 1 then tYear_Student.Acp1 when 3 then tYear_Student.Acp3 else 0 end as Acp, case @xTerm when 1 then tYear_Student.gTerm1 when 3 then tYear_Student.gTerm3 else 0 end as gterm, tmmMark.MarkDoreh,tmmMark.Summark FROM tYear_Student left outer JOIN (select xStudent,MarkDoreh,Summark from tMarkDoreh where typ=5 and xtest=@xTest and xStudent in (select xStudent from tYear_Student where XClass =@xClass and xYear=@xYear ) )tmmMark ON tYear_Student.xStudent = tmmMark.xStudent where tYear_Student.XClass =@xClass and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
declare @xStudent bigint declare @Mark float declare @tmp_Mark float declare @Rotbe int declare @tmp_Rotbe int
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1
declare Rbt2 cursor for select xStudent,MarkKoll from #tmpTable where AcpFinal=1 order by MarkKoll desc open Rbt2 fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Mark=10000 while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin if @tmp_Mark <> @Mark begin UPDATE #tmpTable SET gclsKoll = @tmp_Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent set @Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe end else begin UPDATE #tmpTable SET gclsKoll = @Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent end
set @tmp_Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe+1 set @tmp_Mark = @Mark
fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
update #tmpTable set markkoll=round(markkoll,2)
select #tmpTable.*,0 as acp ,tYear_Student.id,tYear_Student.sort,tStudent.FName,tStudent.LName,tStudent.PName,tStudent.Code, tStudent.NumberAsas, case #tmpTable.AcpFinal when 1 then -1 else #tmpTable.AcpFinal end as acpSort from #tmpTable inner join tStudent on #tmpTable.xStudent=tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent drop table #tmpTable

Summark10 float, Summark11 float,

insert into #tmpTable (xStudent,xPaye,acp,acp1,MarkKoll,Summark,tosifM,level5,countBookStd) SELECT tYear_Student.xStudent,tYear_Student.XPaye,tYear_Student.acp3,tYear_Student.acp1,TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.Summark, dbo.ReturnTosifM5(TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.xtest,TmpMark.xStudent) as TosifM ,dbo.ReturnLevel5(TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.xtest,TmpMark.xStudent) as level5,0
FROM tYear_Student left outer JOIN (select xStudent,xtest,MarkDoreh,Summark from tMarkDoreh where typ=5 and xtest=@Exam and xStudent in (select xStudent from tYear_Student where XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and xYear=@xYear ) )TmpMark ON tYear_Student.xStudent = TmpMark.xStudent
WHERE tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
update #tmpTable set MarkKoll1=tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,Summark1=tmpMark1.Summark,gclsKoll1=tmpMark1.gClass, tosifM_1=dbo.ReturnTosifM5(tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,@ExamTerm1,tmpMark1.xStudent), level5_1=dbo.ReturnLevel5(tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,@ExamTerm1,tmpMark1.xStudent)
from #tmpTable inner join ( SELECT xStudent, MarkDoreh, gClass, Summark FROM tMarkDoreh WHERE (typ = 5) AND (Xtest = @ExamTerm1))tmpMark1 on #tmpTable.xstudent=tmpMark1.xstudent
update #tmpTable set MarkKoll2=tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,Summark2=tmpMark1.Summark from #tmpTable inner join ( SELECT xStudent, MarkDoreh, gClass, Summark FROM tMarkDoreh WHERE (typ = 5) AND (Xtest = @ExamTerm2))tmpMark1 on #tmpTable.xstudent=tmpMark1.xstudent

update #tmpTable set Summark11=tMarkAgo.mark,gClass11=tMarkAgo.gClass FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent where tMarkAgo.xpaye = 11 and tMarkAgo.typ=5
declare Test cursor for /* SELECT DISTINCT @Exam, dbo.tYear_Student.xPaye, dbo.tMark.xbook, dbo.tBook.Name, dbo.tBook.sort FROM dbo.tStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tMark ON dbo.tStudent.id = dbo.tMark.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tBook ON dbo.tMark.xbook = dbo.tBook.id AND dbo.tYear_Student.xPaye = dbo.tBook.xPaye Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tMark.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear) and tBook.vezarat=1 ORDER BY tMark.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.sort, tMark.xbook */
SELECT DISTINCT @Exam, tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.id, tBook.Name, tBook.sort FROM tYear_Student INNER JOIN tBook ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tBook.xPaye Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tBook.vezarat=1 and tBook.id in(select distinct xbook from tmark where xtest=@Exam) or tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tBook.vezarat=1 and tBook.id in(select distinct xbook from tMarkAgo where xstudent in(select xstudent from tYear_Student where XClass in (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)))) ORDER BY tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.sort, tBook.id
open Test fetch next from Test into @xTest,@xPaye,@xbook,@book,@sort Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin
if( @tmp_xTest <>@xTest or @tmp_xPaye <>@xPaye) set @counter =1
if(@counter<22) begin set @Sql=' update #tmpTable set xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'='+convert(varchar(6),@xbook)+',book'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=N'''+@book+''''+ ' WHERE xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye)
exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set MAgo10_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkAgo.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMarkAgo.xpaye = 10 AND tMarkAgo.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set MAgo11_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkAgo.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMarkAgo.xpaye = 11 AND tMarkAgo.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m3_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m2_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m2' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m1_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m1' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql) End set @counter=@counter+1 set @tmp_xTest=@xTest set @tmp_xPaye=@xPaye
fetch next from Test into @xTest,@xPaye,@xbook,@book,@sort
end
close Test deallocate Test

--13990814 ALTER TABLE dbo.tYear_Student ADD notShowBalance bit NULL GO ALTER TABLE dbo.tYear_Student ADD CONSTRAINT DF_tYear_Student_notShowBalance DEFAULT 0 FOR notShowBalance GO update tYear_Student set notShowBalance=0 where notShowBalance is null GO alter procedure dbo.sp_RptPaymentBalance1 @Class varchar(500) , @xYear int, @Fasl int, @Balance int with encryption as update tYear_Student set notShowBalance=0 where notShowBalance is null
select tmpPay.*,(AmountMostPayTransPort+AmountMostPayFee)-StdPay as Balance, AmountMostPayTransPort-Pay_Transport as Balance_Transport, AmountMostPayFee-Pay_Fee as Balance_Fee,
@Fasl as Fasl from (SELECT isnull(tYear_Student.notShowBalance,0) as notShowBalance, tYear_Student.xPaye, tYear_Student.xClass, tYear_Student.xStudent, tYear_Student.sort, tStudent.FName, tStudent.LName, tStudent.PName, tClass.answerable, tClass.name AS Class, tPaye.Name AS Paye, tParmetr.heder1, tParmetr.sch, tStudent.NumberAsas, case @Fasl when 1 then isnull(tYear_Student.transport1,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport2,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport3,0)
when 2 then isnull(tYear_Student.transport1,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport2,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport3,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport4,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport5,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport6,0)
when 3 then isnull(tYear_Student.transport1,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport2,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport3,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport4,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport5,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport6,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport7,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport8,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.transport9,0)
end as AmountMostPayTransPort,
case @Fasl when 1 then isnull(tYear_Student.fee1,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee2,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee3,0)
when 2 then isnull(tYear_Student.fee1,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee2,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee3,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee4,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee5,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee6,0)
when 3 then isnull(tYear_Student.fee1,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee2,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee3,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee4,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee5,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee6,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee7,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee8,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee9,0) end as AmountMostPayFee,
isnull(tmpMali.Pay_Fee,0 ) + isnull(tmpMali.Pay_Transport,0) as StdPay, isnull(tmpMali.Pay_Fee,0 ) as Pay_Fee, isnull(tmpMali.Pay_Transport,0) as Pay_Transport FROM tStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id left outer join
(SELECT xStudent, SUM(Fee) AS Pay_Fee, SUM(Transport) AS Pay_Transport from tPaymentStudent WHERE (xYear = @xYear) and xStudent in(select xstudent from tYear_Student where mali=1 and xYear = @xYear and xclass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) ) GROUP BY xStudent)tmpMali on tYear_Student.xStudent=tmpMali.xStudent
CROSS JOIN tParmetr WHERE (tYear_Student.mali = 1) AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear) and tYear_Student.xclass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)))tmpPay where (AmountMostPayTransPort+AmountMostPayFee)-StdPay>=@Balance

when 8 then isnull(tYear_Student.fee1,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee2,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee3,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee4,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee5,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee6,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee7,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee8,0)
when 9 then isnull(tYear_Student.fee1,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee2,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee3,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee4,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee5,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee6,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee7,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee8,0)+ isnull(tYear_Student.fee9,0)
end as AmountMostPayFee,
isnull(tmpMali.Pay_Fee,0 ) + isnull(tmpMali.Pay_Transport,0) as StdPay, isnull(tmpMali.Pay_Fee,0 ) as Pay_Fee, isnull(tmpMali.Pay_Transport,0) as Pay_Transport FROM tStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id left outer join
(SELECT xStudent, SUM(Fee) AS Pay_Fee, SUM(Transport) AS Pay_Transport from tPaymentStudent WHERE (xYear = @xYear) and xStudent in(select xstudent from tYear_Student where mali=1 and xYear = @xYear and xclass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) ) GROUP BY xStudent)tmpMali on tYear_Student.xStudent=tmpMali.xStudent
CROSS JOIN tParmetr WHERE (tYear_Student.mali = 1) AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear) and tYear_Student.xclass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)))tmpPay where (AmountMostPayTransPort+AmountMostPayFee)-StdPay>=@Balance

declare @zarib100 float if(@xTerm=0) set @zarib100=1 else if(@xTerm=1) set @zarib100=2.5 else if(@xTerm=2) set @zarib100=1.666666 else if(@xTerm=3) set @zarib100=1
INSERT INTO tMarkDoreh (xStudent, Xtest, typ, MarkDoreh,SumMark,MarkDoreh100,acp) SELECT tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest, 5 AS Expr1, SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) AS Expr2, SUM(tMark.Mark), round(SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) *@zarib100,6),1 FROM tMark INNER JOIN tBook ON tMark.xbook = tBook.id WHERE (tMark.Mark IS NOT NULL) and (tMark.Xtest =@Exam) and tBook.vahed>0 GROUP BY tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest
if(@xTerm=1) begin update tMarkDoreh set acp=0 where xtest=@Exam and xstudent in( select xstudent as countB from tmark where xtest=@Exam and mark <16 group by xstudent having count(*)>=1)

alter PROCEDURE dbo.spRpt_Listfinal @Exam varchar(500), @Class varchar(500) , @xYear int with encryption AS
create table #tmpTable (xStudent int,xPaye int,MarkKoll float,Summark float,tosifM nvarchar(10),level5 smallint,Acp int,xClass int,countStdClass int)
insert into #tmpTable (xStudent,xClass,xPaye,acp,MarkKoll,Summark,tosifM,level5)
SELECT tYear_Student.xStudent,tYear_Student.xClass,tYear_Student.XPaye,tYear_Student.acp3,TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.Summark, dbo.ReturnTosifM5(TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.xtest,TmpMark.xStudent) as TosifM ,dbo.ReturnLevel5(TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.xtest,TmpMark.xStudent) as level5
FROM tYear_Student left outer JOIN (select xStudent,xtest,MarkDoreh,Summark from tMarkDoreh where typ=5 and xtest=@Exam and xStudent in (select xStudent from tYear_Student where XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and xYear=@xYear ) )TmpMark ON tYear_Student.xStudent = TmpMark.xStudent
WHERE tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
update #tmpTable set countStdClass= tmpCountStdClass.countStd from #tmpTable inner join (select xClass,count(xStudent) as countStd from #tmpTable group by xClass)tmpCountStdClass on #tmpTable.xClass=tmpCountStdClass.xClass
declare @sch nvarchar(100) declare @ost nvarchar(100) declare @cty nvarchar(100)
select @sch=sch,@ost=ost,@cty=cty from tParmetr
select #tmpTable.*,tYear_Student.sort,tStudent.FName,tStudent.LName,tStudent.PName,tStudent.Code, tStudent.bDate, tStudent.Sh_Sh, tStudent.NumberAsas, tStudent.En_Fname, tStudent.En_Lname, tStudent.LastName, tStudent.En_LastName, #tmpTable.XClass,tClass.Name AS Class,tClass.answerable ,tPaye.Name AS Paye, tCity.Name AS City, tOstan.Name AS Ostan, tYear_Student.hazer2 as hazer3, tYear_Student.Ghayeb2 as Ghayeb3, tYear_Student.Mariz2 as Mariz3, tYear_Student.rokhsat2 as rokhsat3 , tClass.countDakhele1, tClass.countDakhele2, tClass.countExam1, tClass.countExam2, tClass.countAcp1, tClass.countAcp2, tClass.countNoAcp1, tClass.countNoAcp2, tClass.countMashrot1, tClass.countMashrot2, tClass.countMazerati1, tClass.countMazerati2, tClass.countAbsent1, tClass.countAbsent2,tClass.Separcheh ,tmpcountDay.countDayTerm1,tmpcountDay.countDayTerm2,tmpcountDay.countDayTerm3,@sch as School,@ost as SchOst,@cty as SchCty ,cast(@xYear as nvarchar) as xYear , tYear_Student.gTerm1,tYear_Student.gTerm3 from #tmpTable inner join tStudent on #tmpTable.xStudent=tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tClass on tYear_Student.xClass=tClass.id inner join tPaye on #tmpTable.xPaye=tPaye.id LEFT OUTER JOIN tCity ON tStudent.xCity = tCity.id LEFT OUTER JOIN tOstan ON tCity.xOstan = tOstan.id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT xMaghta, Term1 as countDayTerm1, Term2 as countDayTerm2 ,isnull(Term1,0)+isnull(Term2,0) as countDayTerm3 FROM tYearMaghtaCountDay WHERE (xYear = @xYear)) tmpcountDay ON tPaye.xMaghta = tmpcountDay.xMaghta where tYear_Student.xYear =@xYear drop table #tmpTable

declare @xTest int declare @Test nvarchar(100) declare @counter int declare @Sql nvarchar(500) declare @NumExam int set @counter=1
create table #TmpCountClass(Xtest int,xPaye int,xClass int,CountClass int) insert into #TmpCountClass SELECT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, tYear_Student.xClass, COUNT(tMarkDoreh.xStudent) AS CountClass FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye,tYear_Student.xClass
create table #TmpCountPaye(Xtest int,xPaye int,CountPaye int) insert into #TmpCountPaye SELECT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, COUNT(tMarkDoreh.xStudent) AS CountPaye FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye create table #tmp (xStudent int, xtest1 int,test1 nvarchar(100),Mark1 float,gSch1 int,gCls1 int, xtest2 int,test2 nvarchar(100),Mark2 float,gSch2 int,gCls2 int, xtest3 int,test3 nvarchar(100),Mark3 float,gSch3 int,gCls3 int, xtest4 int,test4 nvarchar(100),Mark4 float,gSch4 int,gCls4 int, xtest5 int,test5 nvarchar(100),Mark5 float,gSch5 int,gCls5 int, xtest6 int,test6 nvarchar(100),Mark6 float,gSch6 int,gCls6 int, xtest7 int,test7 nvarchar(100),Mark7 float,gSch7 int,gCls7 int, xtest8 int,test8 nvarchar(100),Mark8 float,gSch8 int,gCls8 int, xtest9 int,test9 nvarchar(100),Mark9 float,gSch9 int,gCls9 int ) insert into #tmp (xStudent) SELECT DISTINCT tMarkDoreh.xStudent FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.typ=5 and tMarkDoreh.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam))
declare Test cursor for SELECT DISTINCT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tExam.Name, tExam.NumExam FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tExam.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.xtest not in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tMarkDoreh.xtest in ( SELECT TOP 5 tMarkDoreh.Xtest FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tExam.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.xtest not in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tExam.NumExam ORDER BY tExam.NumExam DESC ) ORDER BY tExam.NumExam open Test fetch next from Test into @xTest,@Test,@NumExam Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin
set @Sql='update #tmp set xtest'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'='+convert(varchar(6),@xTest)+',Test'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=N'''+@Test+'''' exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmp set Mark'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,gSch'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.gPaye,gCls'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.gClass' +' FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN #tmp ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = #tmp.xStudent ' +' WHERE tMarkDoreh.xTest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest) exec(@Sql) set @counter=@counter+1
fetch next from Test into @xTest,@Test,@NumExam
end
close Test deallocate Test
select tmpStd.*, tmpMark.CountAb, tmpMark.M1, tmpMark.M2, tmpMark.M3, tmpMark.M4, tmpMark.M5, tmpMark.M6, tmpMark.M7, tmpMark.M8, tmpMark.M9, tmpMark.M10, tmpMark.Mark, tmpMark.Tosif, tmpMark.gClass, tmpMark.gKoll ,tmpCommentKoll.comment as CommentKoll,tmpavgClass.avgClass from (SELECT tStudent.id as xStudent, tStudent.Code,tStudent.NumberAsas,tStudent.sh_sh, tStudent.FName, tStudent.LName, tStudent.PName,tStudentImg.Student_img, tYear_Student.xPaye, tYear_Student.xClass, 0 as xReshteh,tParmetr.Foter1 as modir,tParmetr.sch as school, tClass.name as Class,tClass.answerable, tPaye.Name AS Paye,tBook.id as xBook, tBook.Name AS Book, tBook.vahed, tBook.sort , tYear_Student.xyear,tYear_Student.hazer1, tYear_Student.hazer2, tYear_Student.Ghayeb1, tYear_Student.Ghayeb2, tYear_Student.Mariz1, tYear_Student.Mariz2, tYear_Student.rokhsat1, tYear_Student.rokhsat2,tMarkDoreh.Summark,tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh100,dbo.ReturnTosif( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest) as TosifMark5,dbo.ReturnLevel( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest) as Level5,dbo.ReturnComment( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest) as Comment5,tMarkDoreh.acp, tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, tMarkDoreh.gClass AS gClassKoll, tMarkDoreh.gPaye AS gPayeKoll, tMarkDoreh.gKoll AS gSchKoll,#TmpCountClass.CountClass,#TmpCountPaye.CountPaye,tTeacher.fnamf as TchFname,tTeacher.fnaml as tchLname, tExam.Name AS Exam, tExam.DateFrom, tExam.DateTo, tExam.NumExam,tbook.TimeWeek, #tmp.test1 ,#tmp.Mark1 ,#tmp.gSch1 ,#tmp.gCls1 , #tmp.test2 ,#tmp.Mark2 ,#tmp.gSch2 ,#tmp.gCls2 , #tmp.test3 ,#tmp.Mark3 ,#tmp.gSch3 ,#tmp.gCls3 , #tmp.test4 ,#tmp.Mark4 ,#tmp.gSch4 ,#tmp.gCls4 , #tmp.test5 ,#tmp.Mark5 ,#tmp.gSch5 ,#tmp.gCls5 , #tmp.test6 ,#tmp.Mark6 ,#tmp.gSch6 ,#tmp.gCls6 , #tmp.test7 ,#tmp.Mark7 ,#tmp.gSch7 ,#tmp.gCls7 , #tmp.test8 ,#tmp.Mark8 ,#tmp.gSch8 ,#tmp.gCls8 , #tmp.test9 ,#tmp.Mark9 ,#tmp.gSch9 ,#tmp.gCls9
FROM tStudent inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id INNER JOIN tBook ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tBook.xpaye INNER JOIN tMarkDoreh ON tStudent.id = tMarkDoreh.xstudent INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id LEFT OUTER JOIN tStudentImg ON tStudent.id = tStudentImg.xStudent CROSS JOIN tParmetr
LEFT OUTER JOIN tTch_Cls on tYear_Student.xClass= tTch_Cls.xCls and tbook.id =tTch_Cls.xLsn LEFT OUTER JOIN tTeacher on tTch_Cls.xTch= tTeacher.id
INNER JOIN #TmpCountClass on tMarkDoreh.Xtest= #TmpCountClass.Xtest and tYear_Student.xPaye=#TmpCountClass.xPaye and tYear_Student.xclass=#TmpCountClass.xclass INNER JOIN #TmpCountPaye on tMarkDoreh.Xtest= #TmpCountPaye.Xtest and tYear_Student.xPaye=#TmpCountPaye.xPaye left outer join #tmp on tStudent.id=#tmp.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.xClass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)))tmpStd left outer join ( select tMark.xStudent,tMark.xtest,tMark.xbook,tMark.CountAb, tMark.M1, tMark.M2, tMark.M3, tMark.M4, tMark.M5, tMark.M6, tMark.M7, tMark.M8, tMark.M9, tMark.M10, tMark.Mark, dbo.ReturnTosif( tMark.Mark,tMark.xtest) as Tosif,dbo.ReturnLevel( tMark.Mark,tMark.xtest) as LevelBook, tMark.gClass, tMark.gKoll from tmark inner join tstudent on tmark.xstudent=tstudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tmark.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xClass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) ) tmpMark on tmpStd.xstudent=tmpMark.xstudent and tmpStd.xbook=tmpMark.xbook left outer join ( SELECT tComnentKarname.xStudent, tComnentKarname.Xtest, tComnentKarname.Comment FROM tComnentKarname INNER JOIN tStudent ON tComnentKarname.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tComnentKarname.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear AND tYear_Student.XClass IN (SELECT * FROM SplitNumber(@Class)) AND tComnentKarname.xtest IN (SELECT * FROM SplitNumber(@Exam)) ) tmpCommentKoll on tmpStd.xstudent=tmpCommentKoll.xstudent
left outer join (SELECT dbo.tMark.Xtest,tMark.xbook, dbo.tYear_Student.xClass, AVG(dbo.tMark.Mark) AS AvgClass FROM dbo.tMark INNER JOIN dbo.tStudent ON dbo.tMark.xStudent = dbo.tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE tMark.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xClass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and (dbo.tMark.typ = 1) GROUP BY dbo.tMark.Xtest,tMark.xbook, dbo.tYear_Student.xClass) tmpavgClass on tmpStd.xClass=tmpavgClass.xClass and tmpMark.Xtest=tmpavgClass.Xtest and tmpMark.xbook=tmpavgClass.xbook
drop table #TmpCountClass drop table #TmpCountPaye drop table #tmp

SELECT tMark.xStudent, tStudent.Code,tStudent.NumberAsas,tStudent.sh_sh, tStudent.FName, tStudent.LName, tStudent.PName,tStudentImg.Student_img, tYear_Student.xPaye, tYear_Student.xClass,0 as xReshteh,tParmetr.Foter1 as modir,tParmetr.sch as school, tClass.name as Class,tClass.answerable, tPaye.Name AS Paye, tBook.Name AS Book, tBook.vahed, tBook.sort , tYear_Student.xyear, tYear_Student.hazer1, tYear_Student.hazer2, tYear_Student.Ghayeb1, tYear_Student.Ghayeb2, tYear_Student.Mariz1, tYear_Student.Mariz2, tYear_Student.rokhsat1, tYear_Student.rokhsat2,tMarkDoreh.Summark,tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh100,dbo.ReturnTosif( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest) as TosifMark5,dbo.ReturnLevel( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest) as Level5,dbo.ReturnComment( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest) as Comment5,tMarkDoreh.acp, tMark.CountAb, tMark.M1, tMark.M2, tMark.M3, tMark.M4, tMark.M5, tMark.M6, tMark.M7, tMark.M8, tMark.M9, tMark.M10, tMark.Mark, dbo.ReturnTosif( tMark.Mark,tMark.xtest) as Tosif,dbo.ReturnLevel( tMark.Mark,tMark.xtest) as LevelBook, tMark.gClass, tMark.gKoll, tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, tMarkDoreh.gClass AS gClassKoll, tMarkDoreh.gPaye AS gPayeKoll, tMarkDoreh.gKoll AS gSchKoll,#TmpCountClass.CountClass,#TmpCountPaye.CountPaye,tTeacher.fnamf as TchFname,tTeacher.fnaml as tchLname, tExam.Name AS Exam, tExam.DateFrom, tExam.DateTo, tExam.NumExam,tbook.TimeWeek, tmpCommentKoll.comment as CommentKoll,tmpavgClass.avgClass, #tmp.test1 ,#tmp.Mark1 ,#tmp.gSch1 ,#tmp.gCls1 , #tmp.test2 ,#tmp.Mark2 ,#tmp.gSch2 ,#tmp.gCls2 , #tmp.test3 ,#tmp.Mark3 ,#tmp.gSch3 ,#tmp.gCls3 , #tmp.test4 ,#tmp.Mark4 ,#tmp.gSch4 ,#tmp.gCls4 , #tmp.test5 ,#tmp.Mark5 ,#tmp.gSch5 ,#tmp.gCls5 , #tmp.test6 ,#tmp.Mark6 ,#tmp.gSch6 ,#tmp.gCls6 , #tmp.test7 ,#tmp.Mark7 ,#tmp.gSch7 ,#tmp.gCls7 , #tmp.test8 ,#tmp.Mark8 ,#tmp.gSch8 ,#tmp.gCls8 , #tmp.test9 ,#tmp.Mark9 ,#tmp.gSch9 ,#tmp.gCls9
FROM tMark INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMark.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id INNER JOIN tBook ON tMark.xbook = tBook.id INNER JOIN tExam ON tMark.Xtest = tExam.id INNER JOIN tMarkDoreh ON tMark.Xtest = tMarkDoreh.Xtest AND tMark.xStudent = tMarkDoreh.xStudent LEFT OUTER JOIN tStudentImg ON tStudent.id = tStudentImg.xStudent CROSS JOIN tParmetr
LEFT OUTER JOIN tTch_Cls on tYear_Student.xClass= tTch_Cls.xCls and tMark.xbook =tTch_Cls.xLsn LEFT OUTER JOIN tTeacher on tTch_Cls.xTch= tTeacher.id
INNER JOIN #TmpCountClass on tMark.Xtest= #TmpCountClass.Xtest and tYear_Student.xPaye=#TmpCountClass.xPaye and tYear_Student.xclass=#TmpCountClass.xclass INNER JOIN #TmpCountPaye on tMark.Xtest= #TmpCountPaye.Xtest and tYear_Student.xPaye=#TmpCountPaye.xPaye left outer join #tmp on tStudent.id=#tmp.xStudent left outer join ( SELECT tComnentKarname.xStudent, tComnentKarname.Xtest, tComnentKarname.Comment FROM tComnentKarname INNER JOIN tStudent ON tComnentKarname.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tComnentKarname.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear AND tYear_Student.XClass IN (SELECT * FROM SplitNumber(@Class)) AND tComnentKarname.xtest IN (SELECT * FROM SplitNumber(@Exam)) ) tmpCommentKoll on tStudent.id=tmpCommentKoll.xstudent left outer join (SELECT dbo.tMark.Xtest,tMark.xbook, dbo.tYear_Student.xClass, AVG(dbo.tMark.Mark) AS AvgClass FROM dbo.tMark INNER JOIN dbo.tStudent ON dbo.tMark.xStudent = dbo.tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE tMark.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.xClass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and (dbo.tMark.typ = 1) GROUP BY dbo.tMark.Xtest,tMark.xbook, dbo.tYear_Student.xClass) tmpavgClass on tYear_Student.xClass=tmpavgClass.xClass and tMark.Xtest=tmpavgClass.Xtest and tMark.xbook=tmpavgClass.xbook WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tMark.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.xClass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) drop table #TmpCountClass drop table #TmpCountPaye drop table #tmp

GO alter table tMarkDoreh add gClass2 int,gPaye2 int ,gKoll2 int GO alter procedure dbo.sp_CalcMarkDoreh @Exam int with encryption as declare @xYear int declare @xTerm int select @xYear=xYear,@xTerm=term from texam where id=@Exam delete from tMarkDoreh where Xtest=@Exam and typ<>4

--13980513 UPDATE tVer SET ver = N'VkFCV0FGSUFUZ0JPQUZVQU9RQkVBRThBU0FCa0FFOEFWUUI2QUdnQU5BQlVBRmdBWXdCeUFGRUFWUUJSQUhjQVVRQldBRUlBVWdCTUFGRUFQUUE5QUE9PQ==' GO alter FUNCTION dbo.ReturnComment(@Mark float,@xExam int,@xStudent int) RETURNS nvarchar(1000) with encryption AS BEGIN declare @term smallint select @term=term from tExam where id=@xExam declare @comment nvarchar(1000) if @Mark=40 and @term=1 set @Mark=39.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=3 set @Mark=99.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=0 set @Mark=99.9999
if (@term=1 or @term=3) begin declare @acp smallint select @acp =acp from tMarkDoreh where xStudent=@xStudent and xtest=@xExam if(@acp=1) SELECT @comment= comment FROM tTosif WHERE (fromMark <= @Mark) AND (toMark > @Mark) and term=@term
else SELECT @comment= comment FROM tTosif WHERE lev=5 and term=@term
end
else begin
SELECT @comment= comment FROM tTosif WHERE (fromMark <= @Mark) AND (toMark > @Mark) and term=@term end return @comment end
GO CREATE FUNCTION dbo.ReturnLevel5(@Mark float,@xExam int,@xStudent int) RETURNS smallint with encryption AS BEGIN declare @term smallint select @term=term from tExam where id=@xExam declare @Lev smallint if @Mark=40 and @term=1 set @Mark=39.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=3 set @Mark=99.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=0 set @Mark=99.9999
if (@term=1 or @term=3) begin declare @acp smallint select @acp =acp from tMarkDoreh where xStudent=@xStudent and xtest=@xExam if(@acp=1) SELECT @Lev= lev FROM tTosif WHERE (fromMark <= @Mark) AND (toMark > @Mark) and term=@term
else set @Lev=5 end
else begin SELECT @Lev= lev FROM tTosif WHERE (fromMark <= @Mark) AND (toMark > @Mark) and term=@term end
return @Lev end
GO CREATE FUNCTION dbo.ReturnTosifM5(@Mark float,@xExam int,@xStudent int) RETURNS nvarchar(10) with encryption AS BEGIN declare @term smallint select @term=term from tExam where id=@xExam declare @Tosif nvarchar(10) if @Mark=40 and @term=1 set @Mark=39.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=3 set @Mark=99.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=0 set @Mark=99.9999
if (@term=1 or @term=3) begin declare @acp smallint select @acp =acp from tMarkDoreh where xStudent=@xStudent and xtest=@xExam if(@acp=1) SELECT @Tosif= tosifm FROM tTosif WHERE (fromMark <= @Mark) AND (toMark > @Mark) and term=@term
else SELECT @Tosif= tosifm FROM tTosif WHERE lev=5 and term=@term
end
else begin SELECT @Tosif= tosifm FROM tTosif WHERE (fromMark <= @Mark) AND (toMark > @Mark) and term=@term end return @Tosif
end
GO --spRpt_StdKarnameDoreh1 101,'32,33,34,35',1398 alter procedure spRpt_StdKarnameDoreh1 @Exam varchar(500), @Class varchar(500) , @xYear int with encryption as
declare @xTest int declare @Test nvarchar(100) declare @counter int declare @Sql nvarchar(500) declare @NumExam int set @counter=1
create table #TmpCountClass(Xtest int,xPaye int,xClass int,CountClass int) insert into #TmpCountClass SELECT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, tYear_Student.xClass, COUNT(tMarkDoreh.xStudent) AS CountClass FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye,tYear_Student.xClass
create table #TmpCountPaye(Xtest int,xPaye int,CountPaye int) insert into #TmpCountPaye SELECT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, COUNT(tMarkDoreh.xStudent) AS CountPaye FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye create table #tmp (xStudent int, xtest1 int,test1 nvarchar(100),Mark1 float,gSch1 int,gCls1 int, xtest2 int,test2 nvarchar(100),Mark2 float,gSch2 int,gCls2 int, xtest3 int,test3 nvarchar(100),Mark3 float,gSch3 int,gCls3 int, xtest4 int,test4 nvarchar(100),Mark4 float,gSch4 int,gCls4 int, xtest5 int,test5 nvarchar(100),Mark5 float,gSch5 int,gCls5 int, xtest6 int,test6 nvarchar(100),Mark6 float,gSch6 int,gCls6 int, xtest7 int,test7 nvarchar(100),Mark7 float,gSch7 int,gCls7 int, xtest8 int,test8 nvarchar(100),Mark8 float,gSch8 int,gCls8 int, xtest9 int,test9 nvarchar(100),Mark9 float,gSch9 int,gCls9 int ) insert into #tmp (xStudent) SELECT DISTINCT tMarkDoreh.xStudent FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.typ=5 and tMarkDoreh.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam))
declare Test cursor for SELECT DISTINCT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tExam.Name, tExam.NumExam FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tExam.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.xtest not in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tMarkDoreh.xtest in ( SELECT TOP 5 tMarkDoreh.Xtest FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tExam.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.xtest not in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tExam.NumExam ORDER BY tExam.NumExam DESC ) ORDER BY tExam.NumExam open Test fetch next from Test into @xTest,@Test,@NumExam Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin
set @Sql='update #tmp set xtest'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'='+convert(varchar(6),@xTest)+',Test'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=N'''+@Test+'''' exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmp set Mark'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,gSch'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.gPaye,gCls'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.gClass' +' FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN #tmp ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = #tmp.xStudent ' +' WHERE tMarkDoreh.xTest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest) exec(@Sql) set @counter=@counter+1
fetch next from Test into @xTest,@Test,@NumExam
end
close Test deallocate Test
SELECT tMark.xStudent, tStudent.Code,tStudent.NumberAsas,tStudent.sh_sh, tStudent.FName, tStudent.LName, tStudent.PName,tStudentImg.Student_img, tYear_Student.xPaye, tYear_Student.xClass,0 as xReshteh,tParmetr.Foter1 as modir,tParmetr.sch as school, tClass.name as Class,tClass.answerable, tPaye.Name AS Paye, tBook.Name AS Book, tBook.vahed, tBook.sort , tYear_Student.xyear, tYear_Student.hazer1, tYear_Student.hazer2, tYear_Student.Ghayeb1, tYear_Student.Ghayeb2, tYear_Student.Mariz1, tYear_Student.Mariz2, tYear_Student.rokhsat1, tYear_Student.rokhsat2,tMarkDoreh.Summark,tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh100,dbo.ReturnTosifM5( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as TosifMark5,dbo.ReturnLevel5( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as Level5,dbo.ReturnComment( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as Comment5,tMarkDoreh.acp, tMark.CountAb, tMark.M1, tMark.M2, tMark.M3, tMark.M4, tMark.M5, tMark.M6, tMark.M7, tMark.M8, tMark.M9, tMark.M10, tMark.Mark, dbo.ReturnTosif( tMark.Mark,tMark.xtest) as Tosif, dbo.ReturnTosifM( tMark.Mark,tMark.xtest) as TosifM,dbo.ReturnLevel( tMark.Mark,tMark.xtest) as LevelBook, tMark.gClass, tMark.gKoll, tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, tMarkDoreh.gClass AS gClassKoll, tMarkDoreh.gPaye AS gPayeKoll, tMarkDoreh.gKoll AS gSchKoll,#TmpCountClass.CountClass,#TmpCountPaye.CountPaye,tTeacher.fnamf as TchFname,tTeacher.fnaml as tchLname, tExam.Name AS Exam, tExam.DateFrom, tExam.DateTo, tExam.NumExam,tbook.TimeWeek, tmpCommentKoll.comment as CommentKoll,tmpavgClass.avgClass, #tmp.test1 ,#tmp.Mark1 ,#tmp.gSch1 ,#tmp.gCls1 , #tmp.test2 ,#tmp.Mark2 ,#tmp.gSch2 ,#tmp.gCls2 , #tmp.test3 ,#tmp.Mark3 ,#tmp.gSch3 ,#tmp.gCls3 , #tmp.test4 ,#tmp.Mark4 ,#tmp.gSch4 ,#tmp.gCls4 , #tmp.test5 ,#tmp.Mark5 ,#tmp.gSch5 ,#tmp.gCls5 , #tmp.test6 ,#tmp.Mark6 ,#tmp.gSch6 ,#tmp.gCls6 , #tmp.test7 ,#tmp.Mark7 ,#tmp.gSch7 ,#tmp.gCls7 , #tmp.test8 ,#tmp.Mark8 ,#tmp.gSch8 ,#tmp.gCls8 , #tmp.test9 ,#tmp.Mark9 ,#tmp.gSch9 ,#tmp.gCls9
FROM tMark INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMark.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id INNER JOIN tBook ON tMark.xbook = tBook.id INNER JOIN tExam ON tMark.Xtest = tExam.id INNER JOIN tMarkDoreh ON tMark.Xtest = tMarkDoreh.Xtest AND tMark.xStudent = tMarkDoreh.xStudent LEFT OUTER JOIN tStudentImg ON tStudent.id = tStudentImg.xStudent CROSS JOIN tParmetr
LEFT OUTER JOIN tTch_Cls on tYear_Student.xClass= tTch_Cls.xCls and tMark.xbook =tTch_Cls.xLsn LEFT OUTER JOIN tTeacher on tTch_Cls.xTch= tTeacher.id
INNER JOIN #TmpCountClass on tMark.Xtest= #TmpCountClass.Xtest and tYear_Student.xPaye=#TmpCountClass.xPaye and tYear_Student.xclass=#TmpCountClass.xclass INNER JOIN #TmpCountPaye on tMark.Xtest= #TmpCountPaye.Xtest and tYear_Student.xPaye=#TmpCountPaye.xPaye left outer join #tmp on tStudent.id=#tmp.xStudent left outer join ( SELECT tComnentKarname.xStudent, tComnentKarname.Xtest, tComnentKarname.Comment FROM tComnentKarname INNER JOIN tStudent ON tComnentKarname.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tComnentKarname.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear AND tYear_Student.XClass IN (SELECT * FROM SplitNumber(@Class)) AND tComnentKarname.xtest IN (SELECT * FROM SplitNumber(@Exam)) ) tmpCommentKoll on tStudent.id=tmpCommentKoll.xstudent left outer join (SELECT dbo.tMark.Xtest,tMark.xbook, dbo.tYear_Student.xClass, AVG(dbo.tMark.Mark) AS AvgClass FROM dbo.tMark INNER JOIN dbo.tStudent ON dbo.tMark.xStudent = dbo.tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE tMark.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.xClass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and (dbo.tMark.typ = 1) GROUP BY dbo.tMark.Xtest,tMark.xbook, dbo.tYear_Student.xClass) tmpavgClass on tYear_Student.xClass=tmpavgClass.xClass and tMark.Xtest=tmpavgClass.Xtest and tMark.xbook=tmpavgClass.xbook WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tMark.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.xClass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) drop table #TmpCountClass drop table #TmpCountPaye drop table #tmp
GO --spRpt_StdKarnameDoreh2 101,'32,33,34,35',1398 alter procedure dbo.spRpt_StdKarnameDoreh2 @Exam varchar(500), @Class varchar(500) , @xYear int with encryption as
declare @xTest int declare @Test nvarchar(100) declare @counter int declare @Sql nvarchar(500) declare @NumExam int set @counter=1
create table #TmpCountClass(Xtest int,xPaye int,xClass int,CountClass int) insert into #TmpCountClass SELECT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, tYear_Student.xClass, COUNT(tMarkDoreh.xStudent) AS CountClass FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye,tYear_Student.xClass
create table #TmpCountPaye(Xtest int,xPaye int,CountPaye int) insert into #TmpCountPaye SELECT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, COUNT(tMarkDoreh.xStudent) AS CountPaye FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye create table #tmp (xStudent int, xtest1 int,test1 nvarchar(100),Mark1 float,gSch1 int,gCls1 int, xtest2 int,test2 nvarchar(100),Mark2 float,gSch2 int,gCls2 int, xtest3 int,test3 nvarchar(100),Mark3 float,gSch3 int,gCls3 int, xtest4 int,test4 nvarchar(100),Mark4 float,gSch4 int,gCls4 int, xtest5 int,test5 nvarchar(100),Mark5 float,gSch5 int,gCls5 int, xtest6 int,test6 nvarchar(100),Mark6 float,gSch6 int,gCls6 int, xtest7 int,test7 nvarchar(100),Mark7 float,gSch7 int,gCls7 int, xtest8 int,test8 nvarchar(100),Mark8 float,gSch8 int,gCls8 int, xtest9 int,test9 nvarchar(100),Mark9 float,gSch9 int,gCls9 int ) insert into #tmp (xStudent) SELECT DISTINCT tMarkDoreh.xStudent FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.typ=5 and tMarkDoreh.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam))
declare Test cursor for SELECT DISTINCT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tExam.Name, tExam.NumExam FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tExam.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.xtest not in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tMarkDoreh.xtest in ( SELECT TOP 5 tMarkDoreh.Xtest FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tExam.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.xtest not in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tExam.NumExam ORDER BY tExam.NumExam DESC ) ORDER BY tExam.NumExam open Test fetch next from Test into @xTest,@Test,@NumExam Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin
set @Sql='update #tmp set xtest'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'='+convert(varchar(6),@xTest)+',Test'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=N'''+@Test+'''' exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmp set Mark'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,gSch'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.gPaye,gCls'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.gClass' +' FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN #tmp ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = #tmp.xStudent ' +' WHERE tMarkDoreh.xTest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest) exec(@Sql) set @counter=@counter+1
fetch next from Test into @xTest,@Test,@NumExam
end
close Test deallocate Test
select tmpStd.*, tmpMark.CountAb, tmpMark.M1, tmpMark.M2, tmpMark.M3, tmpMark.M4, tmpMark.M5, tmpMark.M6, tmpMark.M7, tmpMark.M8, tmpMark.M9, tmpMark.M10, tmpMark.Mark, tmpMark.Tosif,tmpMark.TosifM ,tmpMark.LevelBook ,tmpMark.gClass, tmpMark.gKoll ,tmpCommentKoll.comment as CommentKoll,tmpavgClass.avgClass from (SELECT tStudent.id as xStudent, tStudent.Code,tStudent.NumberAsas,tStudent.sh_sh, tStudent.FName, tStudent.LName, tStudent.PName,tStudentImg.Student_img, tYear_Student.xPaye, tYear_Student.xClass, 0 as xReshteh,tParmetr.Foter1 as modir,tParmetr.sch as school, tClass.name as Class,tClass.answerable, tPaye.Name AS Paye,tBook.id as xBook, tBook.Name AS Book, tBook.vahed, tBook.sort , tYear_Student.xyear,tYear_Student.hazer1, tYear_Student.hazer2, tYear_Student.Ghayeb1, tYear_Student.Ghayeb2, tYear_Student.Mariz1, tYear_Student.Mariz2, tYear_Student.rokhsat1, tYear_Student.rokhsat2,tMarkDoreh.Summark,tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh100,dbo.ReturnTosifM5( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as TosifMark5,dbo.ReturnLevel5( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as Level5,dbo.ReturnComment( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as Comment5,tMarkDoreh.acp, tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, tMarkDoreh.gClass AS gClassKoll, tMarkDoreh.gPaye AS gPayeKoll, tMarkDoreh.gKoll AS gSchKoll,#TmpCountClass.CountClass,#TmpCountPaye.CountPaye,tTeacher.fnamf as TchFname,tTeacher.fnaml as tchLname, tExam.Name AS Exam, tExam.DateFrom, tExam.DateTo, tExam.NumExam,tbook.TimeWeek, #tmp.test1 ,#tmp.Mark1 ,#tmp.gSch1 ,#tmp.gCls1 , #tmp.test2 ,#tmp.Mark2 ,#tmp.gSch2 ,#tmp.gCls2 , #tmp.test3 ,#tmp.Mark3 ,#tmp.gSch3 ,#tmp.gCls3 , #tmp.test4 ,#tmp.Mark4 ,#tmp.gSch4 ,#tmp.gCls4 , #tmp.test5 ,#tmp.Mark5 ,#tmp.gSch5 ,#tmp.gCls5 , #tmp.test6 ,#tmp.Mark6 ,#tmp.gSch6 ,#tmp.gCls6 , #tmp.test7 ,#tmp.Mark7 ,#tmp.gSch7 ,#tmp.gCls7 , #tmp.test8 ,#tmp.Mark8 ,#tmp.gSch8 ,#tmp.gCls8 , #tmp.test9 ,#tmp.Mark9 ,#tmp.gSch9 ,#tmp.gCls9
FROM tStudent inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id INNER JOIN tBook ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tBook.xpaye INNER JOIN tMarkDoreh ON tStudent.id = tMarkDoreh.xstudent INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id LEFT OUTER JOIN tStudentImg ON tStudent.id = tStudentImg.xStudent CROSS JOIN tParmetr
LEFT OUTER JOIN tTch_Cls on tYear_Student.xClass= tTch_Cls.xCls and tbook.id =tTch_Cls.xLsn LEFT OUTER JOIN tTeacher on tTch_Cls.xTch= tTeacher.id
INNER JOIN #TmpCountClass on tMarkDoreh.Xtest= #TmpCountClass.Xtest and tYear_Student.xPaye=#TmpCountClass.xPaye and tYear_Student.xclass=#TmpCountClass.xclass INNER JOIN #TmpCountPaye on tMarkDoreh.Xtest= #TmpCountPaye.Xtest and tYear_Student.xPaye=#TmpCountPaye.xPaye left outer join #tmp on tStudent.id=#tmp.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.xClass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)))tmpStd left outer join ( select tMark.xStudent,tMark.xtest,tMark.xbook,tMark.CountAb, tMark.M1, tMark.M2, tMark.M3, tMark.M4, tMark.M5, tMark.M6, tMark.M7, tMark.M8, tMark.M9, tMark.M10, tMark.Mark, dbo.ReturnTosif( tMark.Mark,tMark.xtest) as Tosif, dbo.ReturnTosifM( tMark.Mark,tMark.xtest) as TosifM,dbo.ReturnLevel( tMark.Mark,tMark.xtest) as LevelBook, tMark.gClass, tMark.gKoll from tmark inner join tstudent on tmark.xstudent=tstudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tmark.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xClass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) ) tmpMark on tmpStd.xstudent=tmpMark.xstudent and tmpStd.xbook=tmpMark.xbook left outer join ( SELECT tComnentKarname.xStudent, tComnentKarname.Xtest, tComnentKarname.Comment FROM tComnentKarname INNER JOIN tStudent ON tComnentKarname.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tComnentKarname.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear AND tYear_Student.XClass IN (SELECT * FROM SplitNumber(@Class)) AND tComnentKarname.xtest IN (SELECT * FROM SplitNumber(@Exam)) ) tmpCommentKoll on tmpStd.xstudent=tmpCommentKoll.xstudent
left outer join (SELECT dbo.tMark.Xtest,tMark.xbook, dbo.tYear_Student.xClass, AVG(dbo.tMark.Mark) AS AvgClass FROM dbo.tMark INNER JOIN dbo.tStudent ON dbo.tMark.xStudent = dbo.tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE tMark.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xClass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and (dbo.tMark.typ = 1) GROUP BY dbo.tMark.Xtest,tMark.xbook, dbo.tYear_Student.xClass) tmpavgClass on tmpStd.xClass=tmpavgClass.xClass and tmpMark.Xtest=tmpavgClass.Xtest and tmpMark.xbook=tmpavgClass.xbook
drop table #TmpCountClass drop table #TmpCountPaye drop table #tmp
GO UPDATE tTosif SET fromMark = 20 WHERE (term = 1) AND (lev = 4) GO UPDATE tTosif SET tomark = 20 WHERE (term = 1) AND (lev = 5) GO GO UPDATE tTosif SET fromMark = 50 WHERE (term = 3) AND (lev = 4) GO UPDATE tTosif SET tomark = 50 WHERE (term = 3) AND (lev = 5) GO UPDATE tTosif SET fromMark = 50 WHERE (term = 0) AND (lev = 4) GO UPDATE tTosif SET tomark = 50 WHERE (term = 0) AND (lev = 5) GO update texam set procc=0 GO alter procedure dbo.sp_CalcMarkDoreh @Exam int with encryption as declare @xYear int declare @xTerm int select @xYear=xYear,@xTerm=term from texam where id=@Exam delete from tMarkDoreh where Xtest=@Exam and typ<>4
declare @zarib100 float if(@xTerm=0) set @zarib100=1 else if(@xTerm=1) set @zarib100=2.5 else if(@xTerm=2) set @zarib100=1.666666 else if(@xTerm=3) set @zarib100=1
INSERT INTO tMarkDoreh (xStudent, Xtest, typ, MarkDoreh,SumMark,MarkDoreh100,acp) SELECT tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest, 5 AS Expr1, SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) AS Expr2, SUM(tMark.Mark), round(SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) *@zarib100,6),1 FROM tMark INNER JOIN tBook ON tMark.xbook = tBook.id WHERE (tMark.Mark IS NOT NULL) and (tMark.Xtest =@Exam) and tBook.vahed>0 GROUP BY tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest

inner join ( select tMarkDoreh.xstudent,tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, dbo.ReturnTosifM5( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as TosifM5 ,dbo.ReturnLevel5( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as Level5,tMarkDoreh.gClass,tMarkDoreh.gPaye, tMarkDoreh.gKoll, tExam.Name AS Exam, tExam.DateFrom, tExam.DateTo from tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id where tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and typ=5)tmpMark on tmpStd.xstudent=tmpMark.xstudent
GO ALTER procedure dbo.spRpt_ListStdMoadel2 @Exam varchar(500), @Class varchar(500) , @xYear int with encryption as select tmpStd.*, tmpMark.MarkDoreh as Mark, tmpMark.gClass,tmpMark.gPaye,tmpMark.gKoll,tmpMark.Exam, tmpMark.DateFrom, tmpMark.DateTo,tmpMark.TosifM5,tmpMark.Level5 from (SELECT tStudent.id as xStudent, tStudent.FName, tStudent.LName, tStudent.PName, tClass.name AS Class, tPaye.Name AS Paye, tYear_Student.xPaye, @Exam as Xtest,tYear_Student.sort FROM tStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id where tYear_Student.xClass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear) )tmpStd
left outer join ( select tMarkDoreh.xstudent,tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, dbo.ReturnTosifM5( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as TosifM5 ,dbo.ReturnLevel5( tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as Level5,tMarkDoreh.gClass,tMarkDoreh.gPaye, tMarkDoreh.gKoll, tExam.Name AS Exam, tExam.DateFrom, tExam.DateTo from tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id where tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and typ=5)tmpMark on tmpStd.xstudent=tmpMark.xstudent
GO

--13980431 UPDATE tVer SET ver = N'VkFCV0FGSUFUZ0JPQUZVQU9RQkVBRThBU0FCa0FFOEFVUUI2QUdnQU5nQlVBRllBUlFCeUFGRUFWUUJSQUhjQVVRQldBRUlBVWdCTUFGRUFQUUE5QUE9PQ==' GO alter table tTosif add tosifM nvarchar(10),term smallint,lev smallint,comment nvarchar(1000) GO ALTER TABLE dbo.tTosif ADD CONSTRAINT PK_tTosif PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( id ) ON [PRIMARY] GO delete from tTosif GO INSERT INTO tTosif (id, fromMark, toMark, tosif,tosifm, term,lev,comment) VALUES (15, 0, 16, N'نياز به تلاش بيشتر',N'ه', 1,5,N'دانش‌آموز عزيز! نتيجه‌ي امتحان شما قابل قبول نيست؛ اما فرصت داريد در نيمه‌ي دوم سال تعليمي، با تلاش و پشتکار بيشتر به نتيجه‌ي مطلوب رسيده و براي ارتقا صنف در پايان سال، امتياز قابل قبول داشته باشيد.') GO INSERT INTO tTosif (id, fromMark, toMark, tosif,tosifm, term,lev,comment) VALUES (14, 16, 24, N'پذيرفته شده',N'د', 1,4,N'دانش‌آموز عزيز! نتيجه‌ي امتحان شما در حد کاميابي است، اما پيشنهاد مي شود که مشکل درسي خود را به کمک والدين و مدير صنف، شناسايي نموده و براي حل آن اقدام موثر نماييد تا به نتيجه‌ي مطلوب برسيد.') GO INSERT INTO tTosif (id, fromMark, toMark, tosif,tosifm, term,lev,comment) VALUES (13, 24, 30, N'خوب',N'ج', 1,3,N'دانش‌آموز عزيز! نتيجه‌ي امتحان شما (خوب) است و زحمات تان قابل قدر؛ ولي رسيدن به قله‌هاي بلند موفقيت نياز به تلاش بيشتر دارد که با همت بلند خود مي‌توانيد در گروه بسيار خوب و عالي قرار گيريد.') GO INSERT INTO tTosif (id, fromMark, toMark, tosif,tosifm, term,lev,comment) VALUES (12, 30, 36, N'بسيار خوب',N'ب', 1,2,N'دانش‌آموز عزيز! اداره مکتب و استادان کسب مقام (بسيار خوب) را خدمت شما و خانواده محترم تان تبريک عرض مي‌کنند و انتظار دارند که در امتحان بعدي بتوانيد در گروه دانش‌آموزان عالي قرار بگيريد.') GO INSERT INTO tTosif (id, fromMark, toMark, tosif,tosifm, term,lev,comment) VALUES (11, 36, 40, N'عالي',N'الف', 1,1,N'دانش‌آموز عزيز! اداره مکتب و استادان، کسب مقام (عالي) را خدمت شما و خانواده محترم تان تبريک عرض مي نمايند و تلاشهاي شما را قابل تحسين مي دانند. براي شما آرزوي موفقيت‌هاي مزيد داريم.') GO
INSERT INTO tTosif (id, fromMark, toMark, tosif,tosifm, term,lev,comment) VALUES (35, 0, 40, N'تلاش بيشتر',N'ه', 3,5,N'دانش‌آموز عزيز! نتيجه‌ي امتحان شما قابل قبول نيست؛ چون اوسط نمرات کمتر از نصف مجموعه مي‌باشد، پس به اطلاع رسانيده مي‌شود که جهت يادگيري بهتر، همين صنف را در سال آينده تکرار بخوانيد.') GO INSERT INTO tTosif (id, fromMark, toMark, tosif,tosifm, term,lev,comment) VALUES (34, 40, 60, N'پذيرفته شده',N'د', 3,4,N'دانش‌آموز عزيز! نتيجه‌ي امتحان شما در حد کاميابي است؛ پيشنهاد مي شود که مشکل درسي خود را به کمک والدين و مدير صنف، شناسايي نموده و براي حل آن اقدام موثر نماييد تا به نتيجه‌ي مطلوب برسيد.') INSERT INTO tTosif (id, fromMark, toMark, tosif,tosifm, term,lev,comment) VALUES (5, 0, 40, N'تلاش بيشتر',N'ه', 0,5,N'دانش‌آموز عزيز! نتيجه‌ي امتحان شما قابل قبول نيست؛ چون اوسط نمرات کمتر از نصف مجموعه مي‌باشد، پيشنهاد مي شود که مشکل درسي خود را به کمک والدين و مدير صنف، شناسايي نموده و براي حل آن اقدام موثر نماييد تا به نتيجه‌ي مطلوب برسيد.')
