GO INSERT INTO tTosif (id, fromMark, toMark, tosif,tosifm, term,lev,comment) VALUES (3, 60, 75, N'خوب',N'ج', 0,3,N'دانش‌آموز عزيز! نتيجه‌ي امتحان شما (خوب) است و زحمات تان قابل قدر؛ ولي رسيدن به قله‌هاي بلند موفقيت نياز به تلاش بيشتر دارد که با همت بلند خود مي‌توانيد در گروه بسيار خوب و عالي قرار گيريد.') GO INSERT INTO tTosif (id, fromMark, toMark, tosif,tosifm, term,lev,comment) VALUES (2, 75, 90, N'بسيار خوب',N'ب', 0,2,N'دانش‌آموز عزيز! اداره مکتب و استادان کسب مقام (بسيار خوب) را خدمت شما و خانواده محترم تان تبريک عرض مي‌کنند و ما باور داريم که در سال بعدي شما مي‌توانيد در گروه دانش‌آموزان عالي قرار بگيريد.') GO INSERT INTO tTosif (id, fromMark, toMark, tosif,tosifm, term,lev,comment) VALUES (1, 90, 100, N'عالي',N'الف', 0,1,N'دانش‌آموز عزيز! اداره مکتب و استادان، کسب مقام (عالي) را خدمت شما و خانواده محترم تان تبريک عرض مي نمايند و تلاشهاي شما را قابل تحسين مي دانند. درخشش شما در معارف، شايسته تقدير است.') GO alter table tMarkDoreh add MarkDoreh100 float ,Summark float, acp smallint GO alter procedure dbo.sp_CalcMarkDoreh @Exam int with encryption as declare @xYear int declare @xTerm int select @xYear=xYear,@xTerm=term from texam where id=@Exam delete from tMarkDoreh where Xtest=@Exam and typ<>4
declare @zarib100 float if(@xTerm=0) set @zarib100=1 else if(@xTerm=1) set @zarib100=2.5 else if(@xTerm=2) set @zarib100=1.666666 else if(@xTerm=3) set @zarib100=1
INSERT INTO tMarkDoreh (xStudent, Xtest, typ, MarkDoreh,SumMark,MarkDoreh100,acp) SELECT tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest, 5 AS Expr1, SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) AS Expr2, SUM(tMark.Mark), round(SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) *@zarib100,6),1 FROM tMark INNER JOIN tBook ON tMark.xbook = tBook.id WHERE (tMark.Mark IS NOT NULL) and (tMark.Xtest =@Exam) and tBook.vahed>0 GROUP BY tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest
if(@xTerm=1) begin update tMarkDoreh set acp=0 where xtest=@Exam and xstudent in( select xstudent as countB from tmark where xtest=@Exam and mark <16 group by xstudent having count(*)>=1) end else if(@xTerm=3) begin update tMarkDoreh set acp=0 where xtest=@Exam and xstudent in( select xstudent as countB from tmark where xtest=@Exam and mark <16 group by xstudent having count(*)>3) end else if(@xTerm=3) begin update tMarkDoreh set acp=2 where xtest=@Exam and xstudent in( select xstudent as countB from tmark where xtest=@Exam and mark <16 group by xstudent having count(*)<=3) end
declare @xClass int declare @xPaye int declare @xStudent int declare @Mark float declare @tmp_Mark float declare @Rotbe int declare @tmp_Rotbe int
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1
create table #tmp ( xStudent bigint,xClass int,xPaye int,mark float,gClass smallint,gPaye smallint,gKoll smallint) insert into #tmp SELECT tMarkDoreh.xStudent, tYear_Student.xClass,tYear_Student.xPaye, tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, NULL AS Expr1 , NULL AS Expr2, NULL AS Expr3
FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent
where tMarkDoreh.Xtest=@Exam and typ=5 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
---------------------------------------------------------------------- declare Rbt cursor for select distinct xPaye,xClass from #tmp open Rbt fetch next from Rbt into @xPaye,@xClass while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin declare Rbt2 cursor for select xStudent,mark from #tmp where xPaye=@xPaye and xClass=@xClass order by mark desc open Rbt2 fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Mark=1000 while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin if @tmp_Mark <> @Mark begin UPDATE #tmp SET gClass = @tmp_Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent set @Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe end else begin UPDATE #tmp SET gClass = @Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent end
set @tmp_Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe+1 set @tmp_Mark = @Mark
fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
fetch next from Rbt into @xPaye,@xClass end close Rbt deallocate Rbt -----------------------------------------------------
declare Rbt cursor for select distinct xPaye from #tmp open Rbt fetch next from Rbt into @xPaye while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin declare Rbt2 cursor for select xStudent,mark from #tmp where xPaye=@xPaye order by mark desc open Rbt2 fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Mark=1000 while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin if @tmp_Mark <> @Mark begin UPDATE #tmp SET gPaye = @tmp_Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent set @Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe end else begin UPDATE #tmp SET gPaye = @Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent end
set @tmp_Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe+1 set @tmp_Mark = @Mark
fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
fetch next from Rbt into @xPaye end close Rbt deallocate Rbt ---------------------------------------------------- declare Rbt2 cursor for select xStudent,mark from #tmp order by mark desc open Rbt2 fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Mark=1000 while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin if @tmp_Mark <> @Mark begin UPDATE #tmp SET gKoll = @tmp_Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent set @Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe end else begin UPDATE #tmp SET gKoll = @Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent end
set @tmp_Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe+1 set @tmp_Mark = @Mark
fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2
update tMarkDoreh set tMarkDoreh.gClass=#tmp.gClass, tMarkDoreh.gPaye=#tmp.gPaye,tMarkDoreh.gKoll=#tmp.gKoll from tMarkDoreh inner join #tmp on tMarkDoreh.xStudent=#tmp.xStudent and tMarkDoreh.Xtest=@Exam and tMarkDoreh.typ=5 drop table #tmp
GO alter FUNCTION dbo.ReturnTosif(@Mark float,@xExam int) RETURNS nvarchar(50) with encryption AS BEGIN declare @term smallint select @term=term from tExam where id=@xExam declare @Tosif nvarchar(50) if @Mark=40 and @term=1 set @Mark=39.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=3 set @Mark=99.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=0 set @Mark=99.9999
SELECT @Tosif= tosif FROM tTosif WHERE (fromMark <= @Mark) AND (toMark > @Mark) and term=@term return @Tosif end
GO create FUNCTION dbo.ReturnComment(@Mark float,@xExam int) RETURNS nvarchar(1000) with encryption AS BEGIN declare @term smallint select @term=term from tExam where id=@xExam declare @comment nvarchar(1000) if @Mark=40 and @term=1 set @Mark=39.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=3 set @Mark=99.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=0 set @Mark=99.9999
SELECT @comment= comment FROM tTosif WHERE (fromMark <= @Mark) AND (toMark > @Mark) and term=@term return @comment end
GO CREATE FUNCTION dbo.ReturnLevel(@Mark float,@xExam int) RETURNS smallint with encryption AS BEGIN declare @term smallint select @term=term from tExam where id=@xExam declare @Lev smallint if @Mark=40 and @term=1 set @Mark=39.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=3 set @Mark=99.9999 else if @Mark=100 and @term=0 set @Mark=99.9999
SELECT @Lev= lev FROM tTosif WHERE (fromMark <= @Mark) AND (toMark > @Mark) and term=@term return @Lev end
GO --spRpt_StdKarnameDoreh2 101,'32,33,34,35',1398 alter procedure dbo.spRpt_StdKarnameDoreh2 @Exam varchar(500), @Class varchar(500) , @xYear int with encryption as
declare @xTest int declare @Test nvarchar(100) declare @counter int declare @Sql nvarchar(500) declare @NumExam int set @counter=1
create table #TmpCountClass(Xtest int,xPaye int,xClass int,CountClass int) insert into #TmpCountClass SELECT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, tYear_Student.xClass, COUNT(tMarkDoreh.xStudent) AS CountClass FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye,tYear_Student.xClass
create table #TmpCountPaye(Xtest int,xPaye int,CountPaye int) insert into #TmpCountPaye SELECT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, COUNT(tMarkDoreh.xStudent) AS CountPaye FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.Xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye create table #tmp (xStudent int, xtest1 int,test1 nvarchar(100),Mark1 float,gSch1 int,gCls1 int, xtest2 int,test2 nvarchar(100),Mark2 float,gSch2 int,gCls2 int, xtest3 int,test3 nvarchar(100),Mark3 float,gSch3 int,gCls3 int, xtest4 int,test4 nvarchar(100),Mark4 float,gSch4 int,gCls4 int, xtest5 int,test5 nvarchar(100),Mark5 float,gSch5 int,gCls5 int, xtest6 int,test6 nvarchar(100),Mark6 float,gSch6 int,gCls6 int, xtest7 int,test7 nvarchar(100),Mark7 float,gSch7 int,gCls7 int, xtest8 int,test8 nvarchar(100),Mark8 float,gSch8 int,gCls8 int, xtest9 int,test9 nvarchar(100),Mark9 float,gSch9 int,gCls9 int ) insert into #tmp (xStudent) SELECT DISTINCT tMarkDoreh.xStudent FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.typ=5 and tMarkDoreh.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam))
declare Test cursor for SELECT DISTINCT tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tExam.Name, tExam.NumExam FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tExam.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.xtest not in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tMarkDoreh.xtest in ( SELECT TOP 5 tMarkDoreh.Xtest FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN tExam ON tMarkDoreh.Xtest = tExam.id INNER JOIN tStudent ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tExam.xYear=@xYear and tMarkDoreh.xtest not in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) GROUP BY tMarkDoreh.Xtest, tExam.NumExam ORDER BY tExam.NumExam DESC ) ORDER BY tExam.NumExam open Test fetch next from Test into @xTest,@Test,@NumExam Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin
set @Sql='update #tmp set xtest'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'='+convert(varchar(6),@xTest)+',Test'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=N'''+@Test+'''' exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmp set Mark'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,gSch'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.gPaye,gCls'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkDoreh.gClass' +' FROM tMarkDoreh INNER JOIN #tmp ON tMarkDoreh.xStudent = #tmp.xStudent ' +' WHERE tMarkDoreh.xTest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest) exec(@Sql) set @counter=@counter+1
fetch next from Test into @xTest,@Test,@NumExam
end
close Test deallocate Test

--13980514 UPDATE tVer SET ver = N'VkFCV0FGSUFUZ0JPQUZVQU9RQkVBRThBU0FCa0FFOEFWUUI2QUdnQU5BQlVBR3NBUlFCeUFGRUFWUUJSQUhjQVVRQldBRUlBVWdCTUFGRUFQUUE5QUE9PQ==' GO UPDATE tTosif SET fromMark = 20 WHERE (term = 1) AND (lev = 4) GO UPDATE tTosif SET tomark = 20 WHERE (term = 1) AND (lev = 5) GO GO UPDATE tTosif SET fromMark = 50 WHERE (term = 3) AND (lev = 4) GO UPDATE tTosif SET tomark = 50 WHERE (term = 3) AND (lev = 5) GO UPDATE tTosif SET fromMark = 50 WHERE (term = 0) AND (lev = 4) GO UPDATE tTosif SET tomark = 50 WHERE (term = 0) AND (lev = 5) GO update texam set procc=0 GO alter procedure dbo.sp_CalcMarkDoreh @Exam int with encryption as declare @xYear int declare @xTerm int select @xYear=xYear,@xTerm=term from texam where id=@Exam delete from tMarkDoreh where Xtest=@Exam and typ<>4
declare @zarib100 float if(@xTerm=0) set @zarib100=1 else if(@xTerm=1) set @zarib100=2.5 else if(@xTerm=2) set @zarib100=1.666666 else if(@xTerm=3) set @zarib100=1
INSERT INTO tMarkDoreh (xStudent, Xtest, typ, MarkDoreh,SumMark,MarkDoreh100,acp) SELECT tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest, 5 AS Expr1, SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) AS Expr2, SUM(tMark.Mark), round(SUM(tMark.Mark * tBook.vahed) / SUM(tBook.vahed) *@zarib100,6),1 FROM tMark INNER JOIN tBook ON tMark.xbook = tBook.id WHERE (tMark.Mark IS NOT NULL) and (tMark.Xtest =@Exam) and tBook.vahed>0 GROUP BY tMark.xStudent, tMark.Xtest
if(@xTerm=1) begin update tMarkDoreh set acp=0 where xtest=@Exam and xstudent in( select xstudent as countB from tmark where xtest=@Exam and mark <16 group by xstudent having count(*)>=1)

--13990612 CREATE TABLE [dbo].[tComnentStd] ( [id] [int] IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL , [xStudent] [int] NULL , [xYear] [int] NULL , [dayOfWeek] [nvarchar] (20) COLLATE Arabic_CI_AS NULL , [subject] [nvarchar] (200) COLLATE Arabic_CI_AS NULL , [Comment] [nvarchar] (1000) COLLATE Arabic_CI_AS NULL , [DateInsert] [nvarchar] (10) COLLATE Arabic_CI_AS NULL , [TimeInsert] [nvarchar] (10) COLLATE Arabic_CI_AS NULL , [DateUpdate] [nvarchar] (20) COLLATE Arabic_CI_AS NULL , [xUserInsert] [int] NULL , [xUserUpdate] [int] NULL , [deleteDate] [nvarchar] (20) COLLATE Arabic_CI_AS NULL , [xUserDelete] [int] NULL ) ON [PRIMARY] GO
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[tComnentStd] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_tComnentStd] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [id] ) ON [PRIMARY] GO create FUNCTION ReturnMoonBdate(@xStdtunt int) RETURNS nvarchar(20) with encryption AS BEGIN declare @MoonBdate nvarchar(20)
declare @BDate nvarchar(10) declare @xMoonBDate int
select @BDate=bDate from tstudent where id=@xStdtunt
if len(@BDate)=10 begin set @xMoonBDate=cast(substring(@BDate,6,2) as int) if(@xMoonBDate=1) set @MoonBdate=N'حمل' else if(@xMoonBDate=2) set @MoonBdate=N'ثور' else if(@xMoonBDate=3) set @MoonBdate=N'جوزا' else if(@xMoonBDate=4) set @MoonBdate=N'سرطان' else if(@xMoonBDate=5) set @MoonBdate=N'اسد' else if(@xMoonBDate=6) set @MoonBdate=N'سنبله' else if(@xMoonBDate=7) set @MoonBdate=N'میزان' else if(@xMoonBDate=8) set @MoonBdate=N'عقرب' else if(@xMoonBDate=9) set @MoonBdate=N'قوس' else if(@xMoonBDate=10) set @MoonBdate=N'جدی' else if(@xMoonBDate=11) set @MoonBdate=N'دلی' else if(@xMoonBDate=12) set @MoonBdate=N'حوت'
end else set @MoonBdate=null
return @MoonBdate
end GO CREATE FUNCTION ReturnSen(@xStdtunt int,@DateForPrint nvarchar(10)) RETURNS Int with encryption AS BEGIN declare @Sen int
declare @BDate nvarchar(10) declare @xYearBDate int declare @xYearDateForPrint int declare @xMoonBDate int declare @xMoonDateForPrint int
select @BDate=bDate from tstudent where id=@xStdtunt
if len(@BDate)=10 begin set @xYearBDate=cast(substring(@BDate,1,4) as int) set @xYearDateForPrint=cast(substring(@DateForPrint,1,4) as int) set @xMoonBDate=cast(substring(@BDate,6,2) as int) set @xMoonDateForPrint=cast(substring(@DateForPrint,6,2) as int)
if(@xMoonDateForPrint=12 and @xMoonBDate=1) set @xYearDateForPrint=@xYearDateForPrint+1
set @Sen=@xYearDateForPrint-@xYearBDate
end else set @Sen=null
return @Sen
end
GO
CREATE Procedure dbo.sp_tComnentStd_insertUpdate @id int, @xYear int, @xStudent int, @dayOfWeek nvarchar(20), @subject nvarchar(200), @comment nvarchar(1000), @Date nvarchar(10), @Time nvarchar(10), @xUser int with encryption as if(@id=0) begin
INSERT INTO tComnentStd (xYear, xStudent, DateInsert,TimeInsert,dayOfWeek, subject, comment, xUserInsert) VALUES (@xYear, @xStudent, @Date,@Time, @dayOfWeek, @subject, @comment, @xUser) end else begin
UPDATE tComnentStd SET subject =@subject, comment =@comment , DateUpdate =@Date+'-'+@Time, xUserUpdate =@xUser where id=@id
end
GO CREATE procedure dbo.sp_SelectStdForSarbarg_Test_Type1 @type int, @code int, @sort int, @xBook int, @DateExam nvarchar(10), @TimeExam nvarchar(50), @CountPageExam nvarchar(10), @CountQusExam nvarchar(10), @StartExam nvarchar(15), @xYear int with encryption as create table #tmpId(id int) if(@type=0) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear if(@type=1) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xpaye=@code else if(@type=2) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xclass=@code else if(@type=3) insert into #tmpId select id from tstudent where id=@code else if(@type=4) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xhozeh is not null else if(@type=5) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xhozeh=@code
SELECT top 2 tStudent.code as [code_motalem], tYear_Student.idx as [choki], tHozeh.Name as [hoze], tStudent.FName as [Name], tStudent.LName as [valad] , tStudent.FName+ N' ' + tStudent.LName as [Name_valad],tYear_Student.sort as [tartib], tStudent.PName as [valadiyat], tStudent.LastName as [takhalos],tStudent.NumberAsas as [Number_Asas] ,tStudent.Sh_Sh as [Number_Tazkare],tStudent.bDate as [tarikh_tavalod], tStudent.En_Fname as [name_English],tStudent.En_LastName as [takhalos_English],tStudent.En_Lname as [pedar_English], tClass.name as [senf], tPaye.Name as [Paye],tStudentImg.Student_img as [Aks], tmpTch.dabir as [Teacher],(select name from tbook where id=@xBook) as Mazmon ,@DateExam as TarikhExam,@TimeExam as TimeExam,@StartExam as StartExam,@CountPageExam as PageExam,@CountQusExam as QusExam ,case @sort when 1 then cast (tYear_Student.xpaye+100000 as nvarchar)+ '-' +tClass.name+ '-'+ cast (tYear_Student.sort+100000 as nvarchar) +'-'+tStudent.lname+'-'+tStudent.fname when 2 then cast (tYear_Student.xhozeh+100000 as nvarchar)+'-'+ cast (tYear_Student.idx+100000 as nvarchar) end as sortid,tStudent.id as xStudent
FROM tStudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id left outer JOIN tHozeh ON tYear_Student.xhozeh = tHozeh.id left outer JOIN tStudentImg ON tStudent.id = tStudentImg.xStudent left outer JOIN (SELECT tTch_Cls.xCls, tTeacher.fNamF + ' ' + tTeacher.fNamL AS dabir FROM tTch_Cls INNER JOIN tTeacher ON tTch_Cls.xTch = tTeacher.id WHERE (tTch_Cls.xLsn = @xBook) and tTch_Cls.xCls in(select id from tclass where xYear=@xYear ))tmpTch on tYear_Student.xClass =tmpTch.xCls where tstudent.id in(select id from #tmpId ) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear order by tYear_Student.xpaye,tClass.name,tYear_Student.sort,tStudent.lname drop table #tmpId GO

FROM tStudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id left outer JOIN tHozeh ON tYear_Student.xhozeh = tHozeh.id left outer JOIN tStudentImg ON tStudent.id = tStudentImg.xStudent where tstudent.id in(select id from #tmpId ) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear order by tYear_Student.xpaye,tClass.name,tYear_Student.sort,tStudent.lname,tStudent.fname drop table #tmpId

GO CREATE procedure dbo.sp_SelectStdForSarbarg_Type2 @type int, @code varchar(8000), @sort int, @xBook int, @DateExam nvarchar(10), @TimeExam nvarchar(50), @CountPageExam nvarchar(10), @CountQusExam nvarchar(10), @StartExam nvarchar(15), @xYear int with encryption as create table #tmpId(id int) if(@type=0) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear if(@type=1) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xpaye=@code else if(@type=2) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xclass=@code else if(@type=3) insert into #tmpId select id from tstudent where id=@code else if(@type=4) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xhozeh is not null else if(@type=5) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xhozeh=@code
else if(@type=9) insert into #tmpId select id from tstudent where id in(select * from SplitNumber(@code))
SELECT tStudent.code as [code_motalem], tYear_Student.idx as [choki], tHozeh.Name as [hoze], tStudent.FName as [Name], tStudent.LName as [valad] , tStudent.FName+ N' - ' + tStudent.LName as [Name_valad], tStudent.PName as [valadiyat],tYear_Student.sort as [tartib], tStudent.LastName as [takhalos],tStudent.NumberAsas as [Number_Asas] ,tStudent.Sh_Sh as [Number_Tazkare],tStudent.bDate as [tarikh_tavalod], tStudent.En_Fname as [name_English],tStudent.En_LastName as [takhalos_English],tStudent.En_Lname as [pedar_English], MobileFather as [telphon_pedar] ,MobileMother as [telphon_madar] , tClass.name as [senf], tPaye.Name as [Paye],tStudentImg.Student_img as [Aks] -- ,tmpTch.dabir,(select name from tbook where id=@xBook) as Mazmon --,@DateExam as TarikhExam,@TimeExam as TimeExam,@CountPageExam as PageExam ,tStudent.bdate as [tarikh_tavalod],dbo.ReturnSen(tStudent.id,@DateExam) as [sen],cast(cast(substring(tStudent.bdate,9,2) as int) as nvarchar)+' ' + dbo.ReturnMoonBdate(tStudent.id) as [Roz_tavalod] ,case @sort when 1 then cast (tYear_Student.xpaye+100000 as nvarchar)+ '-' +tClass.name+ '-'+ cast (tYear_Student.sort+100000 as nvarchar) +'-'+tStudent.lname+'-'+tStudent.fname when 2 then cast (tYear_Student.xhozeh+100000 as nvarchar)+'-'+ cast (tYear_Student.idx+100000 as nvarchar) end as sortid
FROM tStudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id left outer JOIN tHozeh ON tYear_Student.xhozeh = tHozeh.id left outer JOIN tStudentImg ON tStudent.id = tStudentImg.xStudent where tstudent.id in(select id from #tmpId ) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear order by sortid drop table #tmpId
GO

insert into #tmpTable (xStudent,xPaye,acp,acp1,MarkKoll,Summark,tosifM,level5,countBookStd)
SELECT tYear_Student.xStudent,tYear_Student.XPaye,tYear_Student.acp3,tYear_Student.acp1,TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.Summark, dbo.ReturnTosifM5(TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.xtest,TmpMark.xStudent) as TosifM ,dbo.ReturnLevel5(TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.xtest,TmpMark.xStudent) as level5,0
FROM tYear_Student left outer JOIN (select xStudent,xtest,MarkDoreh,Summark from tMarkDoreh where typ=5 and xtest=@Exam and xStudent in (select xStudent from tYear_Student where XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and xYear=@xYear ) )TmpMark ON tYear_Student.xStudent = TmpMark.xStudent
WHERE tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)

from #tmpTable inner join ( SELECT xStudent, MarkDoreh, gClass, Summark FROM tMarkDoreh WHERE (typ = 5) AND (Xtest = @ExamTerm1))tmpMark1 on #tmpTable.xstudent=tmpMark1.xstudent
update #tmpTable set MarkKoll2=tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,Summark2=tmpMark1.Summark from #tmpTable inner join ( SELECT xStudent, MarkDoreh, gClass, Summark FROM tMarkDoreh WHERE (typ = 5) AND (Xtest = @ExamTerm2))tmpMark1 on #tmpTable.xstudent=tmpMark1.xstudent
update #tmpTable set Summark10=tMarkAgo.mark,gClass10=tMarkAgo.gClass FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent where tMarkAgo.xpaye = 10 and tMarkAgo.typ=5
update #tmpTable set Summark11=tMarkAgo.mark,gClass11=tMarkAgo.gClass FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent where tMarkAgo.xpaye = 11 and tMarkAgo.typ=5
declare Test cursor for /* SELECT DISTINCT @Exam, dbo.tYear_Student.xPaye, dbo.tMark.xbook, dbo.tBook.Name, dbo.tBook.sort FROM dbo.tStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tMark ON dbo.tStudent.id = dbo.tMark.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tBook ON dbo.tMark.xbook = dbo.tBook.id AND dbo.tYear_Student.xPaye = dbo.tBook.xPaye Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tMark.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear) and tBook.vezarat=1 ORDER BY tMark.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.sort, tMark.xbook */
SELECT DISTINCT @Exam, tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.id, tBook.Name, tBook.sort FROM tYear_Student INNER JOIN tBook ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tBook.xPaye Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tBook.vezarat=1 and tBook.id in(select distinct xbook from tmark where xtest=@Exam) or tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tBook.vezarat=1 and tBook.id in(select distinct xbook from tMarkAgo where xstudent in(select xstudent from tYear_Student where XClass in (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)))) ORDER BY tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.sort, tBook.id
open Test fetch next from Test into @xTest,@xPaye,@xbook,@book,@sort Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin
if( @tmp_xTest <>@xTest or @tmp_xPaye <>@xPaye) set @counter =1
if(@counter<22) begin set @Sql=' update #tmpTable set xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'='+convert(varchar(6),@xbook)+',book'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=N'''+@book+''''+ ' WHERE xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye)
exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set MAgo10_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkAgo.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMarkAgo.xpaye = 10 AND tMarkAgo.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set MAgo11_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkAgo.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMarkAgo.xpaye = 11 AND tMarkAgo.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m3_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m2_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m2' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m1_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m1' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql) End set @counter=@counter+1 set @tmp_xTest=@xTest set @tmp_xPaye=@xPaye
fetch next from Test into @xTest,@xPaye,@xbook,@book,@sort
end
close Test deallocate Test

FROM tYear_Student left outer JOIN (select xStudent,xtest,MarkDoreh,Summark from tMarkDoreh where typ=5 and xtest=@Exam and xStudent in (select xStudent from tYear_Student where XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and xYear=@xYear ) )TmpMark ON tYear_Student.xStudent = TmpMark.xStudent

--14000111 ALTER TABLE dbo.tStudent ADD bDateM nvarchar(10) GO UPDATE tItemSabtenamEnable SET lable = N'تاريخ تولد شمسي' WHERE (name = N'txtbDate') GO UPDATE tItemSabtenamEnable SET id = id + 1 WHERE (id >= 6) GO INSERT INTO tItemSabtenamEnable (id, name, lable, Enable) VALUES (6, N'txtbDateM', N'تاريخ تولد ميلادي', 1) GO alter procedure dbo.sp_tStudent_insertUpdate @id int, @xYear int, @xPaye int , @xClass int , @Code bigint , @FName nvarchar(100), @LName nvarchar(100), @PName nvarchar(100), @Sh_Sh nvarchar(200), @bDate nvarchar(10), @bDateM nvarchar(10), @MobileFather nvarchar(11), @MobileMother nvarchar(11), @NumberTelegram nvarchar(11), @NumberTelegram2 nvarchar(11), @Jens smallint, @Mazhab smallint, @NumberAsas int , @RegDate nvarchar(10), @Adress nvarchar (200), @ExitDate nvarchar(10), @Status smallint,
@shaghe bit, @hazer bit, @mali bit, @dakhle bit, @uniform bit, @komakdarsi bit, @ketab bit, @transport bit, @robotic bit, @maghnae bit,
@Fee1 int, @Fee2 int, @Fee3 int, @Fee4 int, @Fee5 int, @Fee6 int, @Fee7 int, @Fee8 int, @Fee9 int, @SumFee int , @xTakhfif smallint, @transport1 int, @transport2 int, @transport3 int, @transport4 int, @transport5 int, @transport6 int, @transport7 int, @transport8 int, @transport9 int, @Sumtransport int, @xDriver int,
@xcity int, @En_Fname nvarchar (100), @En_Lname nvarchar (100), @LastName nvarchar(100), @En_LastName nvarchar(100) ,
@MarkTerm3_From100 bit, @xCityNow int, @codeTakhfif int , @CodeOut int outPut with encryption as if(@id>0) begin if(@Code is not null) begin if exists(select id from tStudent where id<>@id and Code=@Code) begin set @CodeOut=-100 return end end if(@NumberAsas is not null) begin if exists(select id from tStudent where id<>@id and NumberAsas=@NumberAsas ) begin set @CodeOut=-200 return end end UPDATE tStudent SET Code =@Code, FName =@FName, LName =@LName, PName =@PName, Sh_Sh =@Sh_Sh, bDate=@bDate ,bDateM=@bDateM , MobileFather =@MobileFather, MobileMother =@MobileMother, Jens =@Jens, Mazhab =@Mazhab, NumberAsas =@NumberAsas, RegDate =@RegDate, Adress =@Adress, ExitDate =@ExitDate, NumberTelegram=@NumberTelegram,NumberTelegram2=@NumberTelegram2 , xcity=@xcity , En_Fname=@En_Fname, En_Lname=@En_Lname ,En_LastName=@En_LastName ,LastName=@LastName, xCityNow=@xCityNow where id=@id
UPDATE tYear_Student SET xPaye =@xPaye, xClass =@xClass, Status =@Status, shaghe =@shaghe, hazer =@hazer, mali =@mali, dakhle =@dakhle, uniform =@uniform, komakdarsi =@komakdarsi, ketab =@ketab, transport =@transport, robotic =@robotic, maghnae =@maghnae, MarkTerm3_From100=@MarkTerm3_From100 , Fee1=@Fee1, Fee2=@Fee2, Fee3=@Fee3, Fee4=@Fee4, Fee5=@Fee5, Fee6=@Fee6, Fee7=@Fee7, Fee8=@Fee8, Fee9=@Fee9,SumFee=@SumFee ,xTakhfif=@xTakhfif, transport1=@transport1, transport2=@transport2, transport3=@transport3, transport4=@transport4, transport5=@transport5, transport6=@transport6, transport7=@transport7,transport8=@transport8, transport9=@transport9, Sumtransport=@Sumtransport , xDriver =@xDriver,codeTakhfif=@codeTakhfif WHERE (xYear = @xYear) AND (xStudent = @id)
end else begin if(@Code is not null) begin if exists(select id from tStudent where Code=@Code) begin set @CodeOut=-100 return end end if(@NumberAsas is not null) begin if exists(select id from tStudent where NumberAsas=@NumberAsas ) begin set @CodeOut=-200 return end end INSERT INTO tStudent (Code, FName, LName, PName, Sh_Sh,bDate,bDateM, MobileFather, MobileMother, NumberTelegram, NumberTelegram2, Jens, Mazhab, NumberAsas, RegDate, Adress, xcity, En_Fname, En_Lname,En_LastName,LastName,xCityNow) VALUES (@Code, @FName,@LName,@PName,@Sh_Sh,@bDate,@bDateM,@MobileFather,@MobileMother,@NumberTelegram,@NumberTelegram2, @Jens,@Mazhab,@NumberAsas,@RegDate,@Adress,@xcity,@En_Fname,@En_Lname,@En_LastName,@LastName,@xCityNow) set @id=@@identity set @CodeOut=@id INSERT INTO tYear_Student (xYear, xStudent, xPaye, xClass,Status, shaghe, hazer, mali, dakhle, uniform, komakdarsi, ketab, transport, robotic, maghnae,MarkTerm3_From100, Fee1,Fee2,Fee3,Fee4, Fee5,Fee6,Fee7,Fee8,Fee9, SumFee ,xTakhfif, transport1,transport2,transport3,transport4, transport5, transport6,transport7,transport8,transport9,Sumtransport,xDriver,codeTakhfif) VALUES (@xYear, @id, @xPaye, @xClass,@Status, @shaghe, @hazer, @mali, @dakhle, @uniform, @komakdarsi, @ketab, @transport, @robotic, @maghnae, @MarkTerm3_From100, @Fee1,@Fee2,@Fee3,@Fee4, @Fee5,@Fee6,@Fee7,@Fee8,@Fee9,@SumFee, @xTakhfif, @transport1,@transport2,@transport3,@transport4, @transport5, @transport6,@transport7,@transport8,@transport9,@Sumtransport,@xDriver,@codeTakhfif) end

alter PROCEDURE [dbo].[spRpt_karnamefinal] @Exam varchar(500), @Class varchar(500) , @xYear int with encryption AS
declare @ExamTerm1 int declare @ExamTerm2 int
select @ExamTerm1=id from texam where term=1 and xYear=@xYear select @ExamTerm2=id from texam where term=2 and xYear=@xYear
declare @xTest int declare @xbook int declare @book nvarchar(100) declare @xPaye int declare @tmp_xTest int declare @tmp_xPaye int declare @counter int declare @Sql nvarchar(500) declare @sort int
set @tmp_xTest =0 set @tmp_xPaye =0 set @counter=1
create table #tmpTable (xStudent int,xPaye int,MarkKoll float,Summark float,tosifM nvarchar(10),level5 smallint,Acp int, xbook1 int,book1 nvarchar(100),M1_1 float,M2_1 float,M3_1 float, xbook2 int,book2 nvarchar(100),M1_2 float,M2_2 float,M3_2 float, xbook3 int,book3 nvarchar(100),M1_3 float,M2_3 float,M3_3 float, xbook4 int,book4 nvarchar(100),M1_4 float,M2_4 float,M3_4 float, xbook5 int,book5 nvarchar(100),M1_5 float,M2_5 float,M3_5 float, xbook6 int,book6 nvarchar(100),M1_6 float,M2_6 float,M3_6 float, xbook7 int,book7 nvarchar(100),M1_7 float,M2_7 float,M3_7 float, xbook8 int,book8 nvarchar(100),M1_8 float,M2_8 float,M3_8 float, xbook9 int,book9 nvarchar(100),M1_9 float,M2_9 float,M3_9 float, xbook10 int,book10 nvarchar(100),M1_10 float,M2_10 int,M3_10 float, xbook11 int,book11 nvarchar(100),M1_11 float,M2_11 int,M3_11 float, xbook12 int,book12 nvarchar(100),M1_12 float,M2_12 int,M3_12 float, xbook13 int,book13 nvarchar(100),M1_13 float,M2_13 int,M3_13 float, xbook14 int,book14 nvarchar(100),M1_14 float,M2_14 int,M3_14 float, xbook15 int,book15 nvarchar(100),M1_15 float,M2_15 int,M3_15 float, xbook16 int,book16 nvarchar(100),M1_16 float,M2_16 int,M3_16 float, xbook17 int,book17 nvarchar(100),M1_17 float,M2_17 int,M3_17 float, xbook18 int,book18 nvarchar(100),M1_18 float,M2_18 int,M3_18 float, xbook19 int,book19 nvarchar(100),M1_19 float,M2_19 int,M3_19 float, xbook20 int,book20 nvarchar(100),M1_20 float,M2_20 int,M3_20 float, xbook21 int,book21 nvarchar(100),M1_21 float,M2_21 int,M3_21 float, MAgo10_1 float, MAgo10_2 float, MAgo10_3 float, MAgo10_4 float, MAgo10_5 float, MAgo10_6 float, MAgo10_7 float, MAgo10_8 float, MAgo10_9 float, MAgo10_10 float, MAgo10_11 float, MAgo10_12 float, MAgo10_13 float, MAgo10_14 float, MAgo10_15 float, MAgo10_16 float, MAgo10_17 float, MAgo10_18 float, MAgo10_19 float, MAgo10_20 float, MAgo10_21 float, MAgo11_1 float, MAgo11_2 float, MAgo11_3 float, MAgo11_4 float, MAgo11_5 float, MAgo11_6 float, MAgo11_7 float, MAgo11_8 float, MAgo11_9 float, MAgo11_10 float, MAgo11_11 float, MAgo11_12 float, MAgo11_13 float, MAgo11_14 float, MAgo11_15 float, MAgo11_16 float, MAgo11_17 float, MAgo11_18 float, MAgo11_19 float, MAgo11_20 float, MAgo11_21 float, MarkKoll1 float, Summark1 float, Acp1 int, gclsKoll1 int, tosifM_1 nvarchar(10), level5_1 smallint, Summark2 float, MarkKoll2 float, Summark10 float, Summark11 float, gClass10 float, gClass11 float, SumMarkFinal float, countBookStd int )
insert into #tmpTable (xStudent,xPaye,acp,acp1,MarkKoll,Summark,tosifM,level5,countBookStd)
SELECT tYear_Student.xStudent,tYear_Student.XPaye,tYear_Student.acp3,tYear_Student.acp1,TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.Summark, dbo.ReturnTosifM5(TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.xtest,TmpMark.xStudent) as TosifM ,dbo.ReturnLevel5(TmpMark.MarkDoreh,TmpMark.xtest,TmpMark.xStudent) as level5,0
FROM tYear_Student left outer JOIN (select xStudent,xtest,MarkDoreh,Summark from tMarkDoreh where typ=5 and xtest=@Exam and xStudent in (select xStudent from tYear_Student where XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and xYear=@xYear ) )TmpMark ON tYear_Student.xStudent = TmpMark.xStudent
WHERE tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
update #tmpTable set MarkKoll1=tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,Summark1=tmpMark1.Summark,gclsKoll1=tmpMark1.gClass, tosifM_1=dbo.ReturnTosifM5(tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,@ExamTerm1,tmpMark1.xStudent), level5_1=dbo.ReturnLevel5(tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,@ExamTerm1,tmpMark1.xStudent)
from #tmpTable inner join ( SELECT xStudent, MarkDoreh, gClass, Summark FROM tMarkDoreh WHERE (typ = 5) AND (Xtest = @ExamTerm1))tmpMark1 on #tmpTable.xstudent=tmpMark1.xstudent
update #tmpTable set MarkKoll2=tmpMark1.MarkDoreh,Summark2=tmpMark1.Summark from #tmpTable inner join ( SELECT xStudent, MarkDoreh, gClass, Summark FROM tMarkDoreh WHERE (typ = 5) AND (Xtest = @ExamTerm2))tmpMark1 on #tmpTable.xstudent=tmpMark1.xstudent
update #tmpTable set Summark10=tMarkAgo.mark,gClass10=tMarkAgo.gClass FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent where tMarkAgo.xpaye = 10 and tMarkAgo.typ=5
update #tmpTable set Summark11=tMarkAgo.mark,gClass11=tMarkAgo.gClass FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent where tMarkAgo.xpaye = 11 and tMarkAgo.typ=5
declare Test cursor for /* SELECT DISTINCT @Exam, dbo.tYear_Student.xPaye, dbo.tMark.xbook, dbo.tBook.Name, dbo.tBook.sort FROM dbo.tStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tMark ON dbo.tStudent.id = dbo.tMark.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tBook ON dbo.tMark.xbook = dbo.tBook.id AND dbo.tYear_Student.xPaye = dbo.tBook.xPaye Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tMark.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear) and tBook.vezarat=1 ORDER BY tMark.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.sort, tMark.xbook */
SELECT DISTINCT @Exam, tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.id, tBook.Name, tBook.sort FROM tYear_Student INNER JOIN tBook ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tBook.xPaye Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tBook.vezarat=1 and tBook.id in(select distinct xbook from tmark where xtest=@Exam) or tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tBook.vezarat=1 and tBook.id in(select distinct xbook from tMarkAgo where xstudent in(select xstudent from tYear_Student where XClass in (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)))) ORDER BY tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.sort, tBook.id
open Test fetch next from Test into @xTest,@xPaye,@xbook,@book,@sort Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin
if( @tmp_xTest <>@xTest or @tmp_xPaye <>@xPaye) set @counter =1
if(@counter<22) begin set @Sql=' update #tmpTable set xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'='+convert(varchar(6),@xbook)+',book'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=N'''+@book+''''+ ' WHERE xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye)
exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set MAgo10_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkAgo.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMarkAgo.xpaye = 10 AND tMarkAgo.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set MAgo11_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkAgo.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMarkAgo.xpaye = 11 AND tMarkAgo.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m3_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m2_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m2' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m1_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m1' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql) End set @counter=@counter+1 set @tmp_xTest=@xTest set @tmp_xPaye=@xPaye
fetch next from Test into @xTest,@xPaye,@xbook,@book,@sort
end
close Test deallocate Test
update #tmpTable set SumMarkFinal=(isnull(sumMark,0)+isnull(summark10,0)+isnull(summark11,0))/countBookStd where countBookStd>0
declare @sch nvarchar(100) declare @ost nvarchar(100) declare @cty nvarchar(100)
select @sch=sch,@ost=ost,@cty=cty from tParmetr
select #tmpTable.*,tYear_Student.sort,tStudent.FName,tStudent.LName,tStudent.PName,tStudent.Code, tStudent.bDate,tStudent.bDateM, tStudent.Sh_Sh, tStudent.NumberAsas, tStudent.En_Fname, tStudent.En_Lname, tStudent.LastName, tStudent.En_LastName, tCity.Name AS City, tOstan.Name AS Ostan,tYear_Student.XClass, tClass.Name AS Class ,tPaye.Name AS Paye, tStudentImg.Student_img, tYear_Student.hazer1, tYear_Student.hazer2 as hazer3,isnull( tYear_Student.hazer2,0)-isnull( tYear_Student.hazer1,0) as hazer2, tYear_Student.Ghayeb1, tYear_Student.Ghayeb2 as Ghayeb3,isnull( tYear_Student.Ghayeb2,0)-isnull( tYear_Student.Ghayeb1,0) as Ghayeb2, tYear_Student.Mariz1, tYear_Student.Mariz2 as Mariz3, isnull( tYear_Student.Mariz2,0)-isnull( tYear_Student.Mariz1,0) as Mariz2, tYear_Student.rokhsat1, tYear_Student.rokhsat2 as rokhsat3, isnull( tYear_Student.rokhsat2,0)-isnull( tYear_Student.rokhsat1,0) as rokhsat2 , tClass.countDakhele1, tClass.countDakhele2, tClass.countExam1, tClass.countExam2, tClass.countAcp1, tClass.countAcp2, tClass.countNoAcp1, tClass.countNoAcp2, tClass.countMashrot1, tClass.countMashrot2, tClass.countMazerati1, tClass.countMazerati2, tClass.countAbsent1, tClass.countAbsent2,tClass.Separcheh ,tmpcountDay.countDayTerm1,tmpcountDay.countDayTerm2,tmpcountDay.countDayTerm3,@sch as School,@ost as SchOst,@cty as SchCty ,cast(@xYear as nvarchar) as xYear , tmpCommentKoll.Comment as Comment6,tYear_Student.gTerm1,tYear_Student.gTerm3 ,tHazeriAgo.hazer10, tHazeriAgo.hazer11, tHazeriAgo.Ghayeb10, tHazeriAgo.Ghayeb11, tHazeriAgo.Mariz10, tHazeriAgo.Mariz11, tHazeriAgo.rokhsat10, tHazeriAgo.rokhsat11, tHazeriAgo.CountDay10, tHazeriAgo.CountDay11, tHazeriAgo.xYear10, tHazeriAgo.xYear11 from #tmpTable inner join tStudent on #tmpTable.xStudent=tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tClass on tYear_Student.xClass=tClass.id inner join tPaye on #tmpTable.xPaye=tPaye.id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT xMaghta, Term1 as countDayTerm1, Term2 as countDayTerm2 ,isnull(Term1,0)+isnull(Term2,0) as countDayTerm3 FROM tYearMaghtaCountDay WHERE (xYear = @xYear)) tmpcountDay ON tPaye.xMaghta = tmpcountDay.xMaghta left outer JOIN tCity ON tStudent.xCity = tCity.id left outer JOIN tOstan ON tCity.xOstan = tOstan.id LEFT OUTER JOIN tStudentImg ON tStudent.id = tStudentImg.xStudent left outer join ( SELECT tComnentKarname.xStudent, tComnentKarname.Xtest, tComnentKarname.Comment FROM tComnentKarname INNER JOIN tStudent ON tComnentKarname.xStudent = tStudent.id inner join tYear_Student ON tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tComnentKarname.typ = 6) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear AND tYear_Student.XClass IN (SELECT * FROM SplitNumber(@Class)) AND tComnentKarname.xtest IN (SELECT * FROM SplitNumber(@Exam)) ) tmpCommentKoll on tStudent.id=tmpCommentKoll.xstudent left outer join tHazeriAgo on tStudent.id=tHazeriAgo.xStudent where tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear drop table #tmpTable
GO

Create procedure dbo.Sp_SetDefYear @xYear int with encryption as declare @id int if not exists(select id from tExam where xYear=@xYear and term=1) Begin select @id=isnull(max(id),100)+1 from tExam INSERT INTO tExam (id, xYear, NumExam, Name, term) VALUES (@id, @xYear, - 10, N'چهار و نيم ماهه', 1) End if not exists(select id from tExam where xYear=@xYear and term=2) Begin select @id=isnull(max(id),100)+1 from tExam INSERT INTO tExam (id, xYear, NumExam, Name, term) VALUES (@id, @xYear, - 9, N'چهار و نيم ماهه دوم', 2) End if not exists(select id from tExam where xYear=@xYear and term=3) Begin select @id=isnull(max(id),100)+1 from tExam INSERT INTO tExam (id, xYear, NumExam, Name, term) VALUES (@id, @xYear, - 8, N'نهايي', 3) End

declare @xTest int select @xTest=id from tExam where term=@xTerm and xYear=@xYear declare @xbook int declare @book nvarchar(100) declare @counter int declare @Sql nvarchar(500) declare @sort int set @counter=1

declare @xStudent bigint declare @Mark float declare @tmp_Mark float declare @Rotbe int declare @tmp_Rotbe int
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1
declare Rbt2 cursor for select xStudent,MarkKoll from #tmpTable where AcpFinal=1 order by MarkKoll desc open Rbt2 fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark
set @Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Rotbe=1 set @tmp_Mark=10000 while (@@fetch_status = 0) begin if @tmp_Mark <> @Mark begin UPDATE #tmpTable SET gclsKoll = @tmp_Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent set @Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe end else begin UPDATE #tmpTable SET gclsKoll = @Rotbe WHERE xStudent=@xStudent end
set @tmp_Rotbe=@tmp_Rotbe+1 set @tmp_Mark = @Mark
fetch next from Rbt2 into @xStudent,@mark end close Rbt2 deallocate Rbt2

--sp_rptChapShagheHzeri '','32,33,34,35' CREATE procedure dbo.sp_rptListStd @Class varchar(500), @xYear int with encryption as create table #tmp(id int identity ,xClass1 int ,xClass2 int) declare @xclass int declare @xPaye int declare @id int declare @counter int
declare paye cursor for SELECT distinct xpaye FROM tClass WHERE (xYear = @xYear) and id in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and id IN (SELECT xclass FROM tyear_student WHERE xyear = @xYear and xclass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class))) ORDER BY xpaye open paye fetch next from paye into @xPaye Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0) begin
declare class cursor for SELECT id FROM tclass WHERE (xPaye = @xPaye) and id in(select xclass from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear) ORDER BY sortRpt open class fetch next from class into @xclass while (@@fetch_status=0) begin
if(@counter=1) begin insert into #tmp(xclass1)values(@xclass) set @id=@@identity set @counter=2 end else begin update #tmp set xclass2=@xclass where id=@id set @counter=1 end
fetch next from class into @xclass end close class deallocate class
--Set @counter=1 fetch next from paye into @xPaye end close paye deallocate paye
select * from #tmp drop table #tmp

GO --sp_rptChapShaghe '','32,33,34,35' alter procedure dbo.sp_rptChapShaghe @Class varchar(500) , @xYear int with encryption as create table #tmp(id int identity ,xClass int,xbook1 int ,xbook2 int) declare @xclass int declare @xPaye int declare @xbook int declare @id int declare @counter int
declare paye cursor for SELECT xpaye,id FROM tClass WHERE (xYear = @xYear) and id in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and id IN (SELECT xclass FROM tyear_student WHERE xyear = @xYear and xclass in(select * from SplitNumber(@Class))) ORDER BY xpaye,sortRpt open paye fetch next from paye into @xPaye,@xclass Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0) begin

insert into #tmpTable (xStudent,xtest,xPaye,MarkKoll,Summark,tosifM,level5,gschkoll,gPayeKoll,gclsKoll,acp) SELECT distinct tMarkDoreh.xStudent,tMarkDoreh.Xtest,tYear_Student.XPaye,tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, tMarkDoreh.Summark,dbo.ReturnTosifM5(tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as TosifM ,dbo.ReturnLevel5(tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as level5, tMarkDoreh.gKoll,tMarkDoreh.gPaye,tMarkDoreh.gclass,acp FROM tStudent INNER JOIN tMarkDoreh ON tStudent.id = tMarkDoreh.xStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tMarkDoreh.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)

set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m2_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m2' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.Xtest = #tmpTable.xTest AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE #tmpTable.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m1_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m1' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.Xtest = #tmpTable.xTest AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE #tmpTable.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql) End set @counter=@counter+1 set @tmp_xTest=@xTest set @tmp_xPaye=@xPaye

create PROCEDURE dbo.spRpt_Listfinal @Exam varchar(500), @Class varchar(500) , @xYear int with encryption AS
create table #tmpTable (xStudent int,xTest int,xPaye int,MarkKoll float,Summark float,tosifM nvarchar(10),level5 smallint,gschkoll int,gclsKoll int,gPayeKoll int,Acp int )
insert into #tmpTable (xStudent,xtest,xPaye,MarkKoll,Summark,tosifM,level5,gschkoll,gPayeKoll,gclsKoll,acp) SELECT distinct tMarkDoreh.xStudent,tMarkDoreh.Xtest,tYear_Student.XPaye,tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh, tMarkDoreh.Summark,dbo.ReturnTosifM5(tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as TosifM ,dbo.ReturnLevel5(tMarkDoreh.MarkDoreh,tMarkDoreh.xtest,tMarkDoreh.xStudent) as level5, tMarkDoreh.gKoll,tMarkDoreh.gPaye,tMarkDoreh.gclass,acp FROM tStudent INNER JOIN tMarkDoreh ON tStudent.id = tMarkDoreh.xStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent WHERE (tMarkDoreh.typ = 5) and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tMarkDoreh.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear)
---------------محروم دائم----------- insert into #tmpTable(xStudent,xtest,xPaye,acp) SELECT xStudent,@Exam, xPaye,4 FROM tYear_Student WHERE xYear=@xYear and (tYear_Student.Status = 2) and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and xStudent not in(select xStudent from #tmpTable)
--------------معذرتی-----------
insert into #tmpTable(xStudent,xtest,xPaye,acp) SELECT xStudent,@Exam, xPaye,3 FROM tYear_Student WHERE xYear=@xYear and (Status = 1) and tYear_Student.shaghe=1 and tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and xStudent not in(select xStudent from #tmpTable)
--------------معذرتی----------- update #tmpTable set acp=3 where xStudent in(select xStudent from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear and Status=4 and XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)))
---------------محروم دائم----------- update #tmpTable set acp=4 where xStudent in(select xStudent from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear and Status=2 and XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)))
declare @sch nvarchar(100) declare @ost nvarchar(100) declare @cty nvarchar(100)
select @sch=sch,@ost=ost,@cty=cty from tParmetr
select #tmpTable.*,tYear_Student.sort,tStudent.FName,tStudent.LName,tStudent.PName,tStudent.Code, tStudent.bDate, tStudent.Sh_Sh, tStudent.NumberAsas, tStudent.En_Fname, tStudent.En_Lname, tStudent.LastName, tStudent.En_LastName, tYear_Student.XClass, tExam.Name AS Exam,tExam.DateFrom,tExam.DateTo,tClass.Name AS Class ,tPaye.Name AS Paye, tYear_Student.hazer2 as hazer3, tYear_Student.Ghayeb2 as Ghayeb3, tYear_Student.Mariz2 as Mariz3, tYear_Student.rokhsat2 as rokhsat3 , tClass.countDakhele1, tClass.countDakhele2, tClass.countExam1, tClass.countExam2, tClass.countAcp1, tClass.countAcp2, tClass.countNoAcp1, tClass.countNoAcp2, tClass.countMashrot1, tClass.countMashrot2, tClass.countMazerati1, tClass.countMazerati2, tClass.countAbsent1, tClass.countAbsent2 ,tmpcountDay.countDayTerm1,tmpcountDay.countDayTerm2,tmpcountDay.countDayTerm3,@sch as School,@ost as SchOst,@cty as SchCty ,cast(@xYear as nvarchar) as xYear , tYear_Student.gTerm1,tYear_Student.gTerm3 from #tmpTable inner join tStudent on #tmpTable.xStudent=tStudent.id INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tClass on tYear_Student.xClass=tClass.id inner join tPaye on #tmpTable.xPaye=tPaye.id inner join tExam on #tmpTable.xTest=tExam.id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT xMaghta, Term1 as countDayTerm1, Term2 as countDayTerm2 ,isnull(Term1,0)+isnull(Term2,0) as countDayTerm3 FROM tYearMaghtaCountDay WHERE (xYear = @xYear)) tmpcountDay ON tPaye.xMaghta = tmpcountDay.xMaghta drop table #tmpTable GO

insert into #tmpTable (xStudent,xPaye,xClass,acp,acp1,MarkKoll,Summark,tosifM,level5,countBookStd)

FROM tYear_Student left outer JOIN (select xStudent,xtest,MarkDoreh,Summark from tMarkDoreh where typ=5 and xtest=@Exam and xStudent in (select xStudent from tYear_Student where XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and xYear=@xYear ) )TmpMark ON tYear_Student.xStudent = TmpMark.xStudent

update #tmpTable set Summark11=tMarkAgo.mark,gClass11=tMarkAgo.gClass FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent where tMarkAgo.xpaye = 11 and tMarkAgo.typ=5
declare Test cursor for /* SELECT DISTINCT @Exam, dbo.tYear_Student.xPaye, dbo.tMark.xbook, dbo.tBook.Name, dbo.tBook.sort FROM dbo.tStudent INNER JOIN tYear_Student ON tStudent.id = tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tMark ON dbo.tStudent.id = dbo.tMark.xStudent INNER JOIN dbo.tBook ON dbo.tMark.xbook = dbo.tBook.id AND dbo.tYear_Student.xPaye = dbo.tBook.xPaye Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tMark.xtest in(select * from SplitNumber(@Exam)) AND (tYear_Student.xYear = @xYear) and tBook.vezarat=1 ORDER BY tMark.Xtest, tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.sort, tMark.xbook */
SELECT DISTINCT @Exam, tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.id, tBook.Name, tBook.sort FROM tYear_Student INNER JOIN tBook ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tBook.xPaye Where tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tBook.vezarat=1 and tBook.id in(select distinct xbook from tmark where xtest=@Exam) or tYear_Student.XClass IN (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)) and tBook.vezarat=1 and tBook.id in(select distinct xbook from tMarkAgo where xstudent in(select xstudent from tYear_Student where XClass in (select * from SplitNumber(@Class)))) ORDER BY tYear_Student.xPaye, tBook.sort, tBook.id
open Test fetch next from Test into @xTest,@xPaye,@xbook,@book,@sort Set @counter=1 while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin
if( @tmp_xTest <>@xTest or @tmp_xPaye <>@xPaye) set @counter =1
if(@counter<22) begin set @Sql=' update #tmpTable set xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'='+convert(varchar(6),@xbook)+',book'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=N'''+@book+''''+ ' WHERE xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye)
exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set MAgo10_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkAgo.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMarkAgo.xpaye = 10 AND tMarkAgo.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set MAgo11_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tMarkAgo.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMarkAgo INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMarkAgo.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMarkAgo.xpaye = 11 AND tMarkAgo.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m3_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.mark,countBookStd=countBookStd+1' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m2_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m2' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql)
set @Sql='update #tmpTable set m1_'+convert(varchar(2),@counter)+'=tmark.m1' +' FROM tMark INNER JOIN #tmpTable ON tMark.xStudent = #tmpTable.xStudent AND tMark.xBook = #tmpTable.xBook'+convert(varchar(2),@counter) +' WHERE tMark.Xtest = '+convert(varchar(6),@xtest)+' AND #tmpTable.xPaye = '+convert(varchar(6),@xPaye) exec(@Sql) End set @counter=@counter+1 set @tmp_xTest=@xTest set @tmp_xPaye=@xPaye
fetch next from Test into @xTest,@xPaye,@xbook,@book,@sort
end
close Test deallocate Test

--990902 update tRptLable set Caption=N'شماره چوکي با نام' where id=1 GO update tRptLable set Caption=N'شماره چوکي بدون نام' where id=2 GO update tRptLable set Caption=N'ليست رهنما دانش آموزان هر صنف براي مشاهده شماره چوکي و حوزه امتحاني ' where id=7 GO update tRptLable set Caption=N'ليست رهنما دانش آموزان هر پايه براي مشاهده شماره چوکي و حوزه امتحاني' where id=8 GO update tRptChart set Caption=REPLACE(Caption, N'کلاس', N'صنف') GO update tRptChart set Caption=N'نمودار عملکرد استاد در هر درس و صنف' where id=1011 GO
alter table tYear_Student add ShowSarbarg1 bit,ShowSarbarg2 bit, ShowSarbarg3 bit,ShowSarbarg4 bit,ShowSarbarg6 bit,ShowSarbarg7 bit GO ALTER TABLE dbo.tYear_Student ADD CONSTRAINT DF_tYear_Student_ShowSarbarg1 DEFAULT 1 FOR ShowSarbarg1 GO ALTER TABLE dbo.tYear_Student ADD CONSTRAINT DF_tYear_Student_ShowSarbarg2 DEFAULT 1 FOR ShowSarbarg2 GO ALTER TABLE dbo.tYear_Student ADD CONSTRAINT DF_tYear_Student_ShowSarbarg3 DEFAULT 1 FOR ShowSarbarg3 GO ALTER TABLE dbo.tYear_Student ADD CONSTRAINT DF_tYear_Student_ShowSarbarg4 DEFAULT 1 FOR ShowSarbarg4 GO ALTER TABLE dbo.tYear_Student ADD CONSTRAINT DF_tYear_Student_ShowSarbarg6 DEFAULT 1 FOR ShowSarbarg6 GO ALTER TABLE dbo.tYear_Student ADD CONSTRAINT DF_tYear_Student_ShowSarbarg7 DEFAULT 1 FOR ShowSarbarg7 GO update tYear_Student set ShowSarbarg1=1,ShowSarbarg2=1 ,ShowSarbarg3=1,ShowSarbarg4=1,ShowSarbarg6=1,ShowSarbarg7=1 where ShowSarbarg1 is null and Status=1 GO update tYear_Student set ShowSarbarg1=0,ShowSarbarg2=0 ,ShowSarbarg3=0,ShowSarbarg4=0,ShowSarbarg6=0,ShowSarbarg7=0 where ShowSarbarg1 is null and Status<>1 GO alter FUNCTION ReturnMoonBdate(@xStdtunt int) RETURNS nvarchar(20) with encryption AS BEGIN declare @MoonBdate nvarchar(20)
declare @BDate nvarchar(10) declare @xMoonBDate int
select @BDate=bDate from tstudent where id=@xStdtunt
if len(@BDate)=10 begin
if isnumeric(substring(@BDate,6,2)) = 0 return @MoonBdate
set @xMoonBDate=cast(substring(@BDate,6,2) as int) if(@xMoonBDate=1) set @MoonBdate=N'حمل' else if(@xMoonBDate=2) set @MoonBdate=N'ثور' else if(@xMoonBDate=3) set @MoonBdate=N'جوزا' else if(@xMoonBDate=4) set @MoonBdate=N'سرطان' else if(@xMoonBDate=5) set @MoonBdate=N'اسد' else if(@xMoonBDate=6) set @MoonBdate=N'سنبله' else if(@xMoonBDate=7) set @MoonBdate=N'ميزان' else if(@xMoonBDate=8) set @MoonBdate=N'عقرب' else if(@xMoonBDate=9) set @MoonBdate=N'قوس' else if(@xMoonBDate=10) set @MoonBdate=N'جدي' else if(@xMoonBDate=11) set @MoonBdate=N'دلي' else if(@xMoonBDate=12) set @MoonBdate=N'حوت'
end else set @MoonBdate=null
return @MoonBdate
end
GO
alter FUNCTION ReturnSen(@xStdtunt int,@DateForPrint nvarchar(10)) RETURNS Int with encryption AS BEGIN declare @Sen int
declare @BDate nvarchar(10) declare @xYearBDate int declare @xYearDateForPrint int declare @xMoonBDate int declare @xMoonDateForPrint int
select @BDate=bDate from tstudent where id=@xStdtunt
if len(@BDate)=10 begin
if isnumeric(substring(@BDate,1,4)) = 0 return null if isnumeric(substring(@BDate,6,2)) = 0 return null
set @xYearBDate=cast(substring(@BDate,1,4) as int) set @xYearDateForPrint=cast(substring(@DateForPrint,1,4) as int) set @xMoonBDate=cast(substring(@BDate,6,2) as int) set @xMoonDateForPrint=cast(substring(@DateForPrint,6,2) as int)
if(@xMoonDateForPrint=12 and @xMoonBDate=1) set @xYearDateForPrint=@xYearDateForPrint+1
set @Sen=@xYearDateForPrint-@xYearBDate
end else set @Sen=null
return @Sen
end
GO create FUNCTION [dbo].[ReturnStdForNoPrintSarbarg](@formType smallint,@xYear int) RETURNS @RtnValue table ( Data bigint ) with encryption AS BEGIN if(@formType=1 or @formType=5) Insert Into @RtnValue (data) select xstudent from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear and ShowSarbarg1=0 else if(@formType=2) Insert Into @RtnValue (data) select xstudent from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear and ShowSarbarg2=0 else if(@formType=3) Insert Into @RtnValue (data) select xstudent from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear and ShowSarbarg3=0 else if(@formType=4) Insert Into @RtnValue (data) select xstudent from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear and ShowSarbarg4=0 else if(@formType=6) Insert Into @RtnValue (data) select xstudent from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear and ShowSarbarg6=0 else if(@formType=7) Insert Into @RtnValue (data) select xstudent from tYear_Student where xYear=@xYear and ShowSarbarg7=0
Return END
GO alter procedure dbo.sp_SelectStdForSarbarg_Test_Type1 @type int, @code int, @sort int, @xBook int, @DateExam nvarchar(10), @TimeExam nvarchar(50), @CountPageExam nvarchar(10), @CountQusExam nvarchar(10), @StartExam nvarchar(15), @xYear int , @formType smallint with encryption as create table #tmpId(id int) if(@type=0) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear if(@type=1) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xpaye=@code else if(@type=2) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xclass=@code else if(@type=3) insert into #tmpId select id from tstudent where id=@code else if(@type=4) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xhozeh is not null else if(@type=5) insert into #tmpId select tstudent.id from tstudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent where tYear_Student.Status=1 and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xhozeh=@code
SELECT top 2 tStudent.code as [code_motalem], tYear_Student.idx as [choki], tHozeh.Name as [hoze], tStudent.FName as [Name], tStudent.LName as [valad] , tStudent.FName+ N' ' + tStudent.LName as [Name_valad],tYear_Student.sort as [tartib], tStudent.PName as [valadiyat], tStudent.LastName as [takhalos],tStudent.NumberAsas as [Number_Asas] ,tStudent.Sh_Sh as [Number_Tazkare],tStudent.bDate as [tarikh_tavalod], tStudent.En_Fname as [name_English],tStudent.En_LastName as [takhalos_English],tStudent.En_Lname as [pedar_English], tClass.name as [senf], tPaye.Name as [Paye],tStudentImg.Student_img as [Aks], tmpTch.dabir as [Teacher],(select name from tbook where id=@xBook) as Mazmon ,@DateExam as TarikhExam,@TimeExam as TimeExam,@StartExam as StartExam,@CountPageExam as PageExam,@CountQusExam as QusExam ,case @sort when 1 then cast (tYear_Student.xpaye+100000 as nvarchar)+ '-' +tClass.name+ '-'+ cast (tYear_Student.sort+100000 as nvarchar) +'-'+tStudent.lname+'-'+tStudent.fname when 2 then cast (tYear_Student.xhozeh+100000 as nvarchar)+'-'+ cast (tYear_Student.idx+100000 as nvarchar) end as sortid,tStudent.id as xStudent
FROM tStudent inner join tYear_Student on tStudent.id=tYear_Student.xStudent INNER JOIN tPaye ON tYear_Student.xPaye = tPaye.id INNER JOIN tClass ON tYear_Student.xClass = tClass.id left outer JOIN tHozeh ON tYear_Student.xhozeh = tHozeh.id left outer JOIN tStudentImg ON tStudent.id = tStudentImg.xStudent left outer JOIN (SELECT tTch_Cls.xCls, tTeacher.fNamF + ' ' + tTeacher.fNamL AS dabir FROM tTch_Cls INNER JOIN tTeacher ON tTch_Cls.xTch = tTeacher.id WHERE (tTch_Cls.xLsn = @xBook) and tTch_Cls.xCls in(select id from tclass where xYear=@xYear ))tmpTch on tYear_Student.xClass =tmpTch.xCls where tstudent.id in(select id from #tmpId ) and tYear_Student.xYear=@xYear and tYear_Student.xStudent not in(select * from dbo.ReturnStdForNoPrintSarbarg(@formType,@xYear)) order by tYear_Student.xpaye,tClass.name,tYear_Student.sort,tStudent.lname drop table #tmpId
GO

CREATE Procedure dbo.sp_tPaymentStudent_insertUpdate @id int, @xYear int, @xStudent int, @PaynemtDate nvarchar(10), @dayOfWeek nvarchar(20), @NamberBel nvarchar(50), @Fee int, @Transport int, @racing int, @Celebration int, @Exam int, @uniform int, @maghnae int, @ketab int, @komakdarsi int, @dakhle int, @other int, @comment nvarchar(500), @Date nvarchar(20), @xUser int, @code int output with encryption as declare @sumPay int declare @FeeStd int select @FeeStd= SumFee from tYear_Student where xStudent=@xStudent and xYear=@xYear if(@id=0) begin if exists(select id from tPaymentStudent where xStudent=@xStudent and xYear=@xYear and PaynemtDate=@PaynemtDate) begin set @code=-100 return end
else begin
select @sumPay=isnull(Sum(fee),0) from tPaymentStudent where xStudent=@xStudent and xYear=@xYear set @sumPay=isnull(@sumPay,0)+isnull(@Fee,0) if(@sumPay>@FeeStd) begin set @code=-200 return end else begin INSERT INTO tPaymentStudent (xYear, xStudent, PaynemtDate,dayOfWeek, NamberBel, Fee, Transport, racing, Celebration, Exam, uniform, maghnae, ketab, komakdarsi, dakhle, other, comment, DateInsert, xUserInsert) VALUES (@xYear, @xStudent, @PaynemtDate, @dayOfWeek, @NamberBel, @Fee, @Transport, @racing, @Celebration, @Exam, @uniform, @maghnae, @ketab, @komakdarsi, @dakhle, @other, @comment, @Date, @xUser) set @code=@@identity end end end else begin if exists(select id from tPaymentStudent where id<>@id and xStudent=@xStudent and xYear=@xYear and PaynemtDate=@PaynemtDate) begin set @code=-100 return end else begin select @sumPay = isnull(Sum(fee),0) from tPaymentStudent where xStudent=@xStudent and xYear=@xYear and id<>@id set @sumPay = isnull(@sumPay,0)+isnull(@Fee,0) if(@sumPay>@FeeStd) begin set @code=-200 return end else begin UPDATE tPaymentStudent SET PaynemtDate =@PaynemtDate , dayOfWeek =@dayOfWeek , NamberBel =@NamberBel , Fee =@Fee , Transport =@Transport , racing =@racing ,Celebration =@Celebration , Exam =@Exam , uniform =@uniform , maghnae =@maghnae , ketab =@ketab , komakdarsi =@komakdarsi , dakhle =@dakhle , other =@other , comment =@comment , DateUpdate =@Date , xUserUpdate =@xUser where id=@id set @code=@id end end end
GO

--990908 alter FUNCTION ReturnMoonBdate(@xStdtunt int) RETURNS nvarchar(20) with encryption AS BEGIN declare @MoonBdate nvarchar(20)
declare @BDate nvarchar(10) declare @xMoonBDate int
select @BDate=bDate from tstudent where id=@xStdtunt
if len(@BDate)=10 begin
if isnumeric(substring(@BDate,6,2)) = 0 return @MoonBdate
set @xMoonBDate=cast(substring(@BDate,6,2) as int) if(@xMoonBDate=1) set @MoonBdate=N'حمل' else if(@xMoonBDate=2) set @MoonBdate=N'ثور' else if(@xMoonBDate=3) set @MoonBdate=N'جوزا' else if(@xMoonBDate=4) set @MoonBdate=N'سرطان' else if(@xMoonBDate=5) set @MoonBdate=N'اسد' else if(@xMoonBDate=6) set @MoonBdate=N'سنبله' else if(@xMoonBDate=7) set @MoonBdate=N'ميزان' else if(@xMoonBDate=8) set @MoonBdate=N'عقرب' else if(@xMoonBDate=9) set @MoonBdate=N'قوس' else if(@xMoonBDate=10) set @MoonBdate=N'جدي' else if(@xMoonBDate=11) set @MoonBdate=N'دلو' else if(@xMoonBDate=12) set @MoonBdate=N'حوت'
end else set @MoonBdate=null
return @MoonBdate
end
